text: Luneddì, scinziati dâ Stanford University School of Medicine affirmaru la nvinzioni di nu strumentu novu pâ diagnòstica ca sparti li cèlluli pi tipu: nu chip nicu nicu ca po èssiri fattu ccu stampanti inkjet tradizziunali pi circa un centesimu amiricanu l’unu.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Li ricercaturi ncapu ô prugettu dìcunu ca chistu fattu po purtari a attruvari prestu lu cancru, la tubercolosi, l’HIV e la malaria pî pazienti ntê paisi pòviri, unni lu tassu di supravvivènza pî malatii comu lu cancru ô pettu po èssiri la mità di chiḍḍu dê paisi cchiù ricchi.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: JAS 39C Gripen si fraccamàu nta na pista e 9:30 circa di l’orariu locali (0230 UTC) e scuppiàu, e si firmaru tutti li voli commerciali di l’ariuportu.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Lu pilota identificatu fu Dilokrit Pattavee, capusquatra.
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Li nutizzi lucali riportunu ca nu mezzu antincendiu di l' ariupòrtu accapputtàu mentri agghicava.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Lu vintottènni Vidal si juncìu ô Barça tri staggiuni fa dô Sevilla.
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Di quant'avi chi si trasfirìu ntâ capitali catalana, Vidal jucàu 49 partiti pâ squatra.
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: La prutesta accuminciàu all’11.00 di l’ura locàli (UTC+1) a Whitehall, di facci la trasuta sutta survigghianza dâ pulizzìa a Downing Street, la risidenza ufficiali dô Primu ministru.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Appena doppu l’11:00, chiḍḍi ca manifistàvunu bloccàrunu lu tràfficu supra lu vaguni ca si diriggìa a nord versu Whiteall.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: All’11.20, la pulizzìa addummannàu a li prutistanti di spustàrisi supra la banchina, dicènnucci ca lu dirittu di prutistari non duna macari lu dirittu di bluccari lu tràfficu dê màchini.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: All’11.29 la prutesta si spustàu a Whitehall, doppu Trafalgar Square, caminannu pi la zona ditta lu Strand, passannu pi Aldwych, 'nfinu a Kingsway versu Holborn, unni lu Partitu cunservativu avìa lu Spring Forum, all’hotel Grand Connaught Rooms.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Lu record testa a testa di Nadal contru lu canadisi è 7 a 2.
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Pirditti di recenti contru Raonic ntô turnèu Brisbane Open.
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal cunquistàu l' 88% dê punti a riti ntâ partita, vincennu 76 punti ntâ prima battuta.
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Doppu la partita, lu re dâ terra russa dissi, “Nun vidu l’ura di turnari ô giru finàli di l’eventi cchiù mpurtanti. Sugnu ccà pi vìnciri.”
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: “Panama Papers” è n’espressioni ginirali pi circa deci miliuni di documenti di nu studiu legali di Panama, chiamatu Mossack Fonseca, ca la stampa s'attruvàu ntra li manu ntâ primavera 2016.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Li documenti mustravunu quàttordici banchi ca ajutàrunu clienti ricchi a ammucciari miliàrdi di dollari amiricani di ricchezzi pi evitari tassi e àutri normi.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Secunnu lu giurnali britànnicu The Guardian, Deutsche Bank cuntrullava circa nu terzu dê 1200 società fantasmi usati pi realizzari chistu scopu.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Ci foru prostèsti ntâ tuttu lu munnu, vari procedimènti penàli, e li capi dê guvèrni di l’Islanda e dô Pakistan si ritirarunu.
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Ma nascìu a Hong Kong e studiàu a l'università di New York e puru â scola di ligghi di Harvard, e na vota appi puru la risidenza miricana permanenti, ditta “green card”.
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Hsieh, duranti l’elezzioni, fici capiri ca Ma putissi lassari lu Paisi ntâ nu mumentu di crisi.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh sustinìu macari ca lu fotoggènicu Ma avi cchiù stili ca sustanza.
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Nonostanti l’accusi, Ma vincìu facilmenti, riclamannu rilazzioni cchiù stritti cû cuntinenti cinisi.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Lu jucatùri dô jornu è Alex Ovechnik dê Washington Capitals.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: Fici 2 gol e 2 assist ntâ vittoria dô Washington contru Atlanta Trashers 3 a 5.
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Lu primu assist di Ovechkin dâ sirata fu lu goal vincenti dô novu arrivatu Nicklas Backstrom;
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: ccu lu sicunnu goal ca fici arrivàu a 60 goal signati ntâ staggiuni, addivintannu lu primu jucaturi a signari 60 o cchiù goal ntâ na stagiùni sula dô 1995-96, quannu Jaromir Jagr e Mario Lemieux signàrunu chistu record.
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Batten fu classificatu 190mu ntô 2008, ntâ lista dê 400 amiricani cchiù ricchi, ccu nu patrimoniu stimatu di 2,3 miliardi di dòllari.
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: Si lauriàu ntô College of Arts and Sciences di l’Università dâ Virginia ntô 1950 e fu dunatùri impurtànti pî l’istitituzzioni.
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: La priggiuni irachena Abu Ghraib fu data a focu durànti na rivota.
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Lu càrciri divintàu ammuntuatu quannu l’abbusu di n’carzaratu si scuprìu doppu ca li forzi miricani pigghiaru lu cuntrollu.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Piquet Jr. fici nu 'ncidenti ntô Grand Prix di Singapore dô 2008 doppu nu pit stop nticipatu pi Fernando Alonso. La màchina di sicurezza appi a tràsiri ntâ pista.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Quannu la màchina avanti a chiḍḍa di Alonso trasìu pâ binzina, iḍḍu si nni jìu a pigghiàrisi la vittoria.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Piquet Jr. fu licinziatu doppu lu Grand Prix unghirisi dô 2009.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Pròpriu all’8:46, cascàu lu silènziu supra la città, signannu lu mumentu esattu di quannu lu primu jet curpìu lu bersàgliu.
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Dui fasci di luci vìnniru misi pi nnicari versu lu celu di notti.
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Àutri cincu grattacieli sunu in fasi di custruzzioni ntô situ, ccu n’ centru di trasporti e n’ parcu memoriali ô centru.
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: Lu spittaculu dû canali PBS vinciu cchiossài di vinti premi Emmy, secunnu sulu ê spittaculi Sesame Street e Mister Rogers’ Neighborhood.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Tutti l’episodi dô spittàculu si cuncentra supra un argumentu trattatu nna un libbru spicificu e doppu fanu vìdiri storii diversi ca esplòrunu lu stissu argumentu.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Tutti li spittàculi ponu cunzigghiari libbri pî picciriḍḍi, pi fariccilli circari quannu vannu ntâ bibbliuteca.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant, dû canali WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow) dissi “Reading Rainbow 'nzignàu ê picciriddi lu motivu pirchì lèggiri è impurtanti, ci 'nzignau l'amuri di lèggiri. [Lu spittàculu] ajuta li picciriḍḍi a pigghiari un libbru e a lèggiri.”
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: John Grant è fra chiḍḍi ca crìdunu ca puru la a crisi dê finanziamenti e lu canciamentu di filusufìa ntâ prugrammazioni dâ tilivisioni educativa fìciru chiùdiri la serii.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: La timpesta, a quarchi 645 migghia (1.040 km) a ovest di Capo Verde, pari ca si va a calmari annanzi di minazzari li costi, sicunnu li privisioni.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Fred pi comora avi ventu di 105 migghia all’ura (165 km/h) e si sta spustannu versu nord-òvest.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred è lu cicluni trupicali cchiù forti mai arrigistratu finu a ùora ô Sud e puru a Est di l’Atlanticu a accuminciari di quannu nasceru l’immagini satillitari, e è appena lu terzu uragànu cchiù ranni arrigistratu a Est di 35°W.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Lu 24 sittembri 1759, Arhtur Guinness firmò nu cuntrattu d' affìttu di 9.000 anni pû birrificiu St James’ Gate Brewery a Dubblinu, Irlanda.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: 250 anni cchiù tardu, Guinnes addivintàu na cumpagnìa munniali, ccu nu fatturatu di cchiù di 10 miliardi di èuru (14,7 miliardi di dòllari miricani) all’annu.
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, co-pilota dâ squadra dâ Nova Zilanna A1GP oggi signàu la storia guidannu cchiù veloci dô 48enni Harbour Bridge di Auckland, Nova Zilanna, legalmenti.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Lu sig. Reid arriniscìu a guidari la machina Black Beaty dô A1GP dâ Nova Zilanna, a na velocità di cchiù assài di 160 km/h setti voti supra lu ponti.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: La pulizzìa â Nova Zilanna appi probblemi a usari li rilevaturi di velocità pi vìdiri quantu veloci  jeva lu signor Reid a causa di quantu vascia è Black Beauty, e l’ùnica vota ca la pulizzìa arriniscìu a cronomitrari lu signor Reid fu quannu rallintàu a 160 km/h.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Ntê 3 misi passati, cchiossài di 80 carzarati foru fatti nèsciri dâ struttura Central Booking senza èssiri formalmenti accusati.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Ntô misi d' aprili avannu, n’ordinanza ristrittiva temporanea fu emanata dô jùdici Glynn contru la struttura pi fari nèsciri chiḍḍi ca èrunu trattinuti pi cchiissài di 24 uri doppu chi traseru cui nun riciveru n’udienza di nu cummissariu dô tribbunali.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Lu cummissariu stabbilisci na cauzzioni, si cuncessa, e furmalizza l’accusi rigistrati di l’ufficiali d’arrestu. L’accusi vènunu misi ntô sistema dô cumpiuter dô statu, unni lu casu veni tracciatu.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: L’udienza signa la data pû dirittu dô suspittatu a un prucessu ràpidu.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, tisureri australianu, e cui ccu auta probbabbilità va a succèdiri ô Primu ministru John Howard comu capu dô partitu libbirali avìa datu lu so supportu ô setturi d’energìa nucliari nna l' Australia.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Lu signuri Costello dissi ca quannu prudùciri energìa nucleari addiventa cosa fattìbbili economicamènti, l’Australia facissi bonu a usàrila.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: “S' iḍḍu addiventa cummirciali, l’avìssimu aviri. Vogghiu diri ca nun ci sunu obbiezzioni di principiu all’energìa nucliari”, dissi lu signor Costello.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Stannu a li nutizzi di l’Ansa, la polizzìa s'avìa preoccupatu picchì quarchi 'ncursioni di àutu liveḍḍu putìa fari scuppiari na guerra di succissioni.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: La pulizzìa dissi ca Lo Piccolo avìa nu vantaggiu picchì avìa statu manu destra di Provenzano a Palermu e la so ranni spirienza ci fici vìnciri lu rispettu dâ cchiù vecchia generazziuni di boss, datu ca siguitaunu la pòlitica di Provenzano di tinìrisi quantu cchiù vasci possìbbili raffurzannu la riti di putiri.
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Chisti boss avìanu statu cuntrollati di Provenzano quannu iḍḍu misi fini â guerra cumannata di Riina contru lu statu, ca custàu la vita di l’attivisti contru la mafia Giovanni Falcone e Paolo Borsellino ntô 1992.”
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: L’amministraturi delegatu di l’Apple, Steve Jobs, ammustràu lu dispositivu caminannu ntô palcoscènicu e niscennu l’iPhone dâ sacchetta dê so jeans.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Duranti lu so discursu di 2 uri dissi ca “Oggi Apple mmenta n’autra vota lu telèfunu, oggi scrivemu la storia”.
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Lu Brasili è lu cchiù ranni paisi cattòlicu romanu dâ terra, e la chiesa cattòlica romana avìa sempri cuntrastatu la ligalizzazzioni dê matrimoni ntra cristiani dô stissu sessu ntô paisi.
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Lu Cungressu Nazziunali dô Brasili parra di ligalizzazzioni avi 10 anni, e li matrimoni civili sunu ligali sulu a Rio Grande do Sul.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Lu disignu di liggi vinni scrittu dô sinnacu di São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. La liggi proposta, doppu ca vinni modificata, ora comu ora è ntê manu di Roberto Jefferson.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Chiḍḍi ca prutèstunu vòlunu cògghiri na pitizzioni di 1,2 miliuni di firmi di presentari ô Cungressu Nazziunali a nuvèmmiru
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Doppu ca si capiu ca assài famìgghi stàvunu circannu aiutu legali contru lu sfrattu, si tinni na riunioni lu 20 marzu ô Community law center di East Bay pê vìttimi dê truffi immobbiliari.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Quannu l’inquilini ci cuntaru zoccu c’ avìa ammattutu, assài fra l' autri famigghi caperu sùbbitu ca Carolyn Wilson di l’OHA c' avìa arrubatu li caparri e si n'avìa fujutu dâ città.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: L’inquilini di Lockwood Gardens pènzunu ca ci sunu 40 autri famigghi o cchiossài chi arrìsicunu lu sfrattu, datu ca aviànu saputu ca la pulizzìa di l’OHA stava ndagannu supra autri propietà di casi popolari a Oakland ca putìssiru èssiri cascati nê truffi mmobbiliari.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Lu gruppu musicali annullàu lu spittàculu ô War Memorial Stadium di Maui, ca avissi avutu ospitari 9.000 cristiani, scusànnusi ccu li fan.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: La società di gistioni dô gruppu, HK management Inc., a principiu nun desi na motivazzioni pâ cancellazzioni dô 20 sittèmmiru, ma lu jornu doppu desi la curpa a motivi loggìstichi.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Li famusi avvucati grechi, Sakis Kechagioglou e George Nikolakopoulos foru ncarzarati ntô carciri di Ateni di Koryadallus, picchì truvati curpèvuli di cuncussioni e curruzzioni.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Lu risultatu fu petra di scànnalu ranni cca cumunità ligali greca, attraversu l’esposizzioni di azzioni illigàli ca jùdici, avvucati, nutara e prucuratura ligali avìanu fattu l’anni passati.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Quarchi simana fa, doppu l’infurmazziòni pubbricata dô giurnalista Makis Triantafylopoulos ntô so famusu spittaculu TV “Zoungla”, supra TV Alpha, lu membru dô Parlamentu e avvucatu, Petro Mantouvalos, vinni livatu comu mèmbru dô so ufficiu, picchì avìa a cchi fari in attivitati illigali e di curruzzioni.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Nentidimenu, lu jùdici Evangelos Kalousis è ncarzaratu, curpèvuli di curruzioni e comportamèntu deggeneratu.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Robert s’arrifiutàu categoricamènti di riri quannu pensa c’accumincia la vita, na dumanna importanti quannu si parra di l’etica di l’abortu, ricennu ca nun fussi èticu cummintàri li dittagli dê casi probabili.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Comunqui dissi n’ àutra vota quantu dittu annanzi, ca Roe v. Wade era la “giurisprudenza dô paisi”, suttuliniannu la mpurtanza dê liggi dâ Corti Suprema.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Cunfirmàu macari ca cridìa ntô dirittu mplìcitu dâ privacy, di unni dipinneva la dicisioni di Roe.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydore finìu ntâ megghiu manera, cu sei punti di vantaggiu su Noosa ô secùnnu.
text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Li dui squatri s’incòntrunu nta ranni semifinali unni Noosa vincìu di 11 punti.
text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Maroochydore pòi vincìu contru Caboolture ntâ finali priliminari.
text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae è na speci dâ famigghia dê Dromaeosauridae, nu cucinu dô Velociraptor.
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Chist’aceḍḍu rapaci chinu di pinni, a sangu càudu, si pinzava caminassi ccu du' iammi ritti ccu artigghi, comu lu Velociraptor.
text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Lu secunnu artigghiu era cchiù ranni, di unni veni lu nomu Hesperonychus, ca signìfica “artigghiu occidentali”.
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: A parti la ruttura dô ghiacciu, li cunnizziuni dô tempu stremi ana ostacolatu li tintativi di salvataggiu.
text_en: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Pittman dissi ca li cunnizziuni nun ièvunu a miggghiurari nfinu â simana ca stava trasennu.
text_en: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: La quantità e lu spissuri dâ banchisa, sicunnu Pittman, su li peggiu ca li cacciaturi di fochi vìttiru nna l’urtimi 15 anni.
text_en: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Oji, ntâ cumunità di Red Lake, ntô mentri dî funirali di Jeff Wiese e di tri di l'àutri novi vittimi, arrivau la nutizzia ca n’àutru studenti fu arristatu pâ sparatoria ntâ scola dû 21 marzu.
text_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: L’ autoritati dìssiru picca e nenti ufficialmenti, a parti la dichiarazzioni ca fìciru l’arrestu.
text_en: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: Cu tuttu chistu, na funti ca canuscìa l’invistigazziuni dicìa ô giurnali Minneapolis Star-Tribune ca fu Louis Jourdain, lu fìgghiu di sìdici anni di Floyd Jourdain, lu prisidenti dû Red Lake Tribal.
text_en: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: Nun si sapi ancora l' accusa precisa o cchi fu ca purtàu l’auturitati versu lu fìgghiu, ma li pruciduri minurili accumminciaru ntô tribbunali fidirali.
text_en: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text: Lodin dissi macari ca li funziunari dicidìttiru d' annullari lu ballottàggiu pi risparmiari a l’afgani lu costu e lu rìsicu dâ sicuritati di n' àutra elezzioni.
text_en: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text: Li diplumatici dissiru ca attruvàru bastanti ambiguitati ntâ custituzzioni afgana pi dicìdiri ca lu balluttaggiu nun era nicissariu.
text_en: Diplomats said that they had found enough ambiguity in the Afghan constitution to determine the runoff as unnecessary.

text: Chistu cuntraddici li rennicunti d'annanzi, unni si dici ca annullari lu ballottaggiu avissi statu contra la custituzzioni.
text_en: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

text: L’aeriu ava statu purtatu a Irkutsk e era gistitu di truppi nterni.
text_en: The aircraft had been headed to Irkutsk and was being operated by interior troops.

text: Na nnàggini vinni stituita pi virificari.
text_en: An inquiry was established to investigate.

text: Lu II-76 avìa statu nu cumpunenti mpurtanti di l’esèrcitu russu e sovèticu di l’anni sittanta, e avìa già vistu nu ncidenti gravi nna Russia lu misi passatu.
text_en: The Il-76 has been a major component of both the Russian and Soviet military since the 1970s, and had already seen a serious accident in Russia last month.

text: Lu 7 ottobbri nu muturi si persi mentri dû decollu, senza fari firuti o morti. La Russia doppu picca tempu dû ncidenti livàu lu mudeḍḍu II-76s dâ circulazzioni.
text_en: On October 7 an engine separated on takeoff, without injuries. Russia briefly grounded Il-76s after that accident.

text: 800 migghia di l’impiantu dê tubi Trans-Alaska a statu chiusu dopu nu sversamentu di migliaia di barili di petroliu greggio ô sud di Fairbanks, Alaska.
text_en: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

text: N’ tàgghiu di currenti elèttrica doppu un normali test antincendiu fici gràpiri li vàlvuli di scàrricu e lu pitròliu grèggiu si ittàu di fora vicinu la stazzioni di pumpàggiu 9 di Fort Greely.
text_en: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text: L’apirtura dê valvoli causàu n’rilasciu di pressiòni pû sistema e lu petroliu si nn’i ju di na piattaforma â na vasca ca pò teniri 55.000 barili (2,3 miliuni di galloni).
text_en: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text: Mercordì pomeriggiu, li bucchittuni dâ vasca stàvunu ancòra pirdennu a causa di l’esplosioni termali ntâ vasca.
text_en: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text: N’ àutra area di cuntinimentu sutta li vaschi ccu na capienza di 104.500 barili n’avìa statu ancora allinchiuta tutta.
text_en: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

text: Li commenti, n’ diretta â televisioni, era la prima vota ca funti israeliani maggiùri ammittevunu ca li sanziuni stanu avènnu effèttu.
text_en: The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect.

text: Chisti inclùdunu ristrizzioni finanziarii e nu divietu di l’Unioni Europea pi l' esportazzioni di pitròliu greggiu, cui l’economìa di l’Iran ricivi l’80% dê vadagni di èsteru.
text_en: They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income.

text: Ntô rennicuntu scrittu cchiù recenti, l’OPEC dissi ca l’esportazzioni di pitròliu greggiu arrivaru ô liveḍḍu cchiù vàsciu na vint’anni, a 2,8 miliuna di varrili ô jornu.
text_en: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

text: Lu capu massimu dô paìsi, Ayatolla ali Khamenei, descriviu la dipendènza dô petroliu comu “na trappola” esistenti di prima dâ rivoluziòni islamica di l’Iran ntô 1979, di cui lu paìisi s’avissi liberàri.
text_en: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: Quannu la naviceḍḍa arriva ntâ Terra e trasi ntâ l’atmosfèra, ê 5 di matina circa (ura orientali), avìssiru a fari nu bellìssimu spettaculu di luci pê cristiani dâ California dô Nord, l’Òregon, lu Nevada e l’Utah.
text_en: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: La naviceḍḍa cumparirà comu na stiḍḍa cadenti ntô cièlu.
text_en: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: La naviceḍḍa va a viaggiari a circa 12,8 km o 8 migghia o secunnu. Cu chista velocità si putissi iri di San Francisco a Los Angeles ntâ 'n minùtu.
text_en: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: Stardust segnerà un novu record assolutu dâ naviceḍḍa spaziàli cchiù veloci ca torna ntâ Terra, vincennu lu record precedenti dô maggio 1969 dô modulo di comando di Apollo X.
text_en: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: “Si sposterà supra la costa occidintàli dâ California dô nord e illuminerà lu cielu dâ California â l’Oregon centràli, dô Nevada e l’Idaho â l’Utah”, affirmàu Tom Duxbury, capo dô progèttu Stardust.
text_en: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: La decisioni dô Sig. Rudd di firmari l’accordo dô clima di Kyoto ìsula li Stati Unìti, ca sarannu l’unico paìsi sviluppatu a nun ratificari l’accordu.
text_en: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

text: L’ex governu conservativu di l’Australia s’arrifiutau di ratificari lu protocollo di Kyoto, ricennu ca putìa ruvinari l’economìa ca dipenni assài di l’esportazione dô carbùni, mentri paìsi comu l'India e la Cina nun avevunu limiti pi l’emissiòni.
text_en: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.

text: È l’acquisiziuni cchiù ranni ntâ storia di eBay.
text_en: It is the biggest acquisition in eBay's history.

text: La società voli diversificari li so fonti di profittu e divintàri famusa nâ di àrii unni Skype avi na posizioni forti, comu Cina, Europa di l’Est e Brasile.
text_en: The company hopes to diversify its profit sources and gain popularity in areas where Skype holds a strong position, such as China, Eastern Europe, and Brazil.

text: Li scinziati penzanu ca Encelado è geologgicamenti attivu e na fonti pussibbili di l' aneḍḍu di ghiacciu di Saturnu.
text_en: Scientists have suspected Enceladus as geologically active and a possible source of Saturn's icy E ring.

text: Encedalo è l’uggettu cchiù riflessivu ntô sistema solari, e rifletti circa lu 90 percentu dâ luci solari ca lu culpìsci.
text_en: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.

text: L’edituri di giochi Konami rissi oggi ntâ n’giurnali giappunisi ca nun distribuirà lu jocu Sei jorna a Fallujah.
text_en: The game publisher Konami stated today in a Japanese newspaper that they will not be releasing the game Six Days in Fallujah.

text: Lu jocu è ispiratu dî fatti dâ Sicunna Battàgghia di Fallujah, na battàgghia brutali ‘ntra li forzi ‘miricani e iracheni.
text_en: The game is based on the Second Battle of Fallujah, a vicious battle between American and Iraqi forces.

text: L’ACMA visti ca, macari ca lu videu a statu trasmessu supra Internet, lu Grande Fratello nun ha violàto li liggi dâ censura pî contenuti online, datu ca li media nun èrunu stati sabbati supra lu situ dô Grande Fratello.
text_en: The ACMA also found that despite the video being streamed on the Internet, Big Brother had not breached online content censorship laws as the media had not been stored on Big Brother's website.

text: La liggi pôe sirvizi ra trasmissioni descrivi a normativa pî contenuti di internet; nentidimenu, pi èssiri cunsideratu n’contenuto Internet, avìa èssiri presenti fisicamenti supra n’ server.
text_en: The Broadcasting Services Act provides for the regulation of Internet content, however to be considered Internet content, it must physically reside on a server.

text: L’ambasciata dê Stati Uniti a Nairobi, Kenya, avìa pubblicàtu n’avvisu secunnu cui “l’estremisti dâ Somalia” stanu pianificannu di lanciari attentati in Kenya e Etiòpia.
text_en: The United States embassy located in Nairobi, Kenya has issued a warning that "extremists from Somalia" are planning to launch suicide bomb attacks in Kenya and Ethiopia.

text: Li Stati Uniti affirmanu c’anu ricevùtu informaziòni ri na fonti scanusciùta ca parra propriu di l’usu dê kamikaze pi fari sautari ntâ l’aria “luoghi di riferimèntu” in Etiopia e Kenya.
text_en: The U.S. says it has received information from an undisclosed source that specifically mentions the use of suicide bombers to will blow up "prominent landmarks" in Ethiopia and Kenya.

text: Assài prima di The daily show e The Colbert report, Heck e Johnson avianu pinsàtu a na pubblicaziòni pi na parodìa ê notizi - e ra comunicazione re nutìzzi quannu èrunu sturenti â UW ntô 1988.
text_en: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.

text: Da quannu a pinsanu, The onion fu na parodìa veritira importànti, cu n’edizioni stampàta, n’sito internet cu 5.000.000 visitatori ntô misi di ottubbri, pubblicità personali, na rete d’informaziòni attiva h24, podcast e n’atlanti pubblicàtu di picca tempu chiamàtu Our dumb world.
text_en: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.

text: Al Gore e lu Ginirali Tommy Franks parraru noncurantementi dî tituli dê nutizzi ca ci piaceru cchiù àssai (a Gore ci piacìu chiḍḍu quannu The Onion ripurtàu ca iḍḍu e Tipper si stavunu addivirtennu assemi sutta li linzola comu mai annazi, doppu la scunfitta dô 2000 ô Culleggiu elettorali).
text_en: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).

text: Tanti dê so scritturi ebbiru na grande influènza supra li spittaculi di parodìa di Jon Stewart e Stephen Colbert.
text_en: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.

text: L’eventu artisticu è macari parti di na campagna dô Comuni dâ città di Budapest ca voli rilanciàri l’immagini dâ capitali rumèna comu na città ranni criatìva e coloràta.
text_en: The artistic event is also part of a campaign by the Bucharest City Hall that seeks to relaunch the image of the Romanian capital as a creative and colourful metropolis.

text: La cità va a èssiri la prima nti l’Europa sudorientali a ospitari CowParade, l’eventu d’arti pubblicu cchiù granni dô munnu, tra giugnu e agustu di l’annu ca veni.
text_en: The city will be the first in southeastern Europe to host CowParade, the world's largest public art event, between June and August this year.

text: L’annuncio di oggi avìa macàri estesu l’impegno dô guvèrnu di marzo di chistu annu di finanziari àutri vagùni.
text_en: Today's announcement also extended the government's commitment made in March of this year to fund extra carriages.

text: Cu àutri 300 s’arriva a 1.300 vagùni d’accattàri pi allentàri lu sovraffollamèntu.
text_en: An additional 300 brings the total to 1,300 carriages to be acquired to relieve overcrowding.

text: Christopher Garcia, portavuci dô dipartimèntu â pulizzìa di Los Angeles, rissi ca suspettava ca n’criminali masculu è indagato pi violaziòni di domiciliu e nun pi vandalìsmu.
text_en: Christopher Garcia, a spokesperson of the Los Angeles Police Department, said the suspected male offender is being investigated for trespassing rather than vandalism.

text: L’insegna nun vinni danniggiata fisicamenti; la mudìfica vinni fatta usannu tiluni nìuri decorati ccu sìmbuli di paci e cori pi canciari la “O” e lè ggiri na “e” scrivuta nica.
text_en: The sign was not physically damaged; the modification was done using black tarpaulins decorated with signs of peace and heart to alter the "O" to read lowercase "e".

text: La marea di culuri russu è causata di na concentrazzioni cchiù auta dû normali di Karenia brevis, un organismu marinu unicellulari presenti nna natura.
text_en: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.

text: Fatturi naturali ponu n’tricciarisi pi generàri condizioni ideàli, permettennu a st’alga d’aumentàri di nummuru drammaticamènti.
text_en: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.

text: L’alga pruduci na neurotossina ca po tuccari li nervi dê cristiani e dê pisci.
text_en: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.

text: Li pisci spesso morunu pi l’àuta concentraziòni dâ tossina ntâ l’acqua.
text_en: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.

text: Li cristiani si ponu 'nfittari arrispirannu particeḍḍi d’acqua 'nfittati purtati ntâ l’aria dû ventu e dû mari.
text_en: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.

text: Ô so massimu, lu cicluni tropicàli Gonu, nominato pi na cesta di fogghi di palma ntâ lingua dê Maldive, raggiunsi venti sustenuti di 240 km l’ura (149 miglia l’ura).
text_en: At its peak, Tropical Cyclone Gonu, named for a bag of palm leaves in the language of the Maldives, reached sustained winds of 240 kilometers an hour (149 miles per hour) .

text: Chista matina, li venti erunu attornu a 83 km/h, e si pinsava c’avissi cuntinuàtu a rallintàri.
text_en: By early today, winds were around 83 km/h, and it was expect to keep weakening.

text: Mercordì, l’Associazione nazionàli dô basketball dê Stati Uniti (NBA) suspinniu la stagiùni di basketball professionali pê preoccupazioni legate ô COVID-19.
text_en: On Wednesday, the United States' National Basketball Association (NBA) suspended its professional basketball season due to concerns regarding COVID-19.

text: La decisiùni di l’NBA vinni doppu ca n’giocaturi di l’Utah Jazz arrisuttàu positivu ô virus COVID-19.
text_en: The NBA's decision followed a Utah Jazz player testing positive for the COVID-19 virus.

text: Secunnu chistu fossile, significa ca la divisiòni avvinni molto prima di comu fu anticipatu dâ prova molecolàre.
text_en: "Based on this fossil, that means the split is much earlier than has been anticipated by the molecular evidence.

text: “Significa ca tuttu ava ghiessiri misu a posto,” rissi lu ricercatùri dô Servizio pâ ricerca dâ Rift Valley in Etiopia e lu coautore dô studiu, Berhane Asfaw.
text_en: That means everything has to be put back," said researcher at the Rift Valley Research Service in Ethiopia and a co-author of the study, Berhane Asfaw.

text: Finu a ora, AOL potti muvirisi e sviluppari lu mercatu IM ô proprio ritmo, pi èssiri diffusu ntê Stati Unìti.
text_en: Until now, AOL has been able to move and develop the IM market at its own pace, due to its widespread use within the United States.

text: Cu st’accordo in atto, chista libertà putissi finìri.
text_en: With this arrangement in place, this freedom might end.

text: Lu nùmmuru di utenti dê sirvizzi Yahoo! e Microsoft junciuti va a cumpètiri ccu chiḍḍu dê clienti AOL.
text_en: The number of users of the Yahoo! and Microsoft services combined will rival the number of AOL's customers.

text: La banca Northen Rock vinni nazionalizzàta ntô 2008 doppu la rivelaziòni secunnu cui la società avìa ricevutu sostegno d’emergenza dô guvèrnu dô Regno Unìtu.
text_en: The Northern Rock bank had been nationalised in 2008 following the revelation that the company had received emergency support from the UK Government.

text: Northen Rock avìa richièstu supporto pâ so esposizioni duranti la crisi dê mutui subprime dô 2007.
text_en: Northern Rock had required support due to its exposure during the subprime mortgage crisis in 2007.

text: Lu sig. Richard Branson ro Virgin Group avìa n’offerta pâ banca, rifiutàta prima dâ nazionalizzaziàni dâ banca.
text_en: Sir Richard Branson's Virgin Group had a bid for the bank rejected prior to the bank’s nationalisation.

text: Ntô 2010, mentri èra nazziunalizzata, l’attuali banca dâ via principali Northern Rock plc fu spartuta dâ “banca tinta”, Northern Rock (Gistioni patrimoniu).
text_en: In 2010, while nationalised, the current high street bank Northern Rock plc was split from the ‘bad bank’, Northern Rock (Asset Management).

text: Virgin accattàu sulu la “banca bona” di Northen Rock, no la società pâ gestiuni dô patrimòniu.
text_en: Virgin have only purchased the ‘good bank’ of Northern Rock, not the asset management company.

text: Chista avissi a èssiri la quinta vota ntâ storia unni li cristiani anu vistu na cosa ca si cunfirmàu materiali marziànu cascàtu ntâ Terra.
text_en: This is believed to be the fifth time in history that people have observed what turned out to be chemically confirmed martian material falling to Earth.

text: Considerannu i 24.000 meteroiti cascati ntâ Terra, sulu 34 anu statu identificàti comu di origini marziàna.
text_en: Out of the approximately 24,000 known meteorites to have fallen to Earth, only about 34 have been verified to be martian in origin.

text: Quìnnici di chisti rocci su attribuìti â piogga di meteorìti dô scorsu lugliu.
text_en: Fifteen of these rocks are attributed to the meteorite shower last July.

text: Na pocu di chisti petri, ca sunu assài rari ntô pianeta Terra, si vinneru a partiri di 11.000$ finu a arrivari a 22.500$ all'oncia, pi deci voti di quantu costa l'oru.
text_en: Some of the rocks, which are very rare on Earth, are being sold from US$11,000 to $22,500 per ounce, which is about ten times more than the cost of gold.

text: Doppu la gara, Keselowski resta lu campiuni dô Camponiato dê pilòti cu 2.250 punti.
text_en: Following the race, Keselowski remains the Drivers' Championship leader with 2,250 points.

text: Sette punti n’arreri, Johnsono è lu secunnu cu 2.243.
text_en: Seven points behind, Johnson is second with 2,243.

text: Ô terzu postu, Hamlin è vinti punti arreri, ma cincu davanti a Bowyer. Kahne e Truex, Jr. su rispettivamènti quintu e sestu, cu 2.220 e 2.207 punti.
text_en: In third, Hamlin is twenty points behind, but five ahead of Bowyer. Kahne and Truex, Jr. are fifth and sixth respectively with 2,220 and 2,207 points.

text: Stewart, Gordon, Kenseth e Harvick cumplètunu li primi dèci pusizzioni dô Campionàtu dê piloti cu quattru cursi c'arrèstunu di fari ntâ chista stagiùni.
text_en: Stewart, Gordon, Kenseth, and Harvick round out the top-ten positions for the Drivers' Championship with four races remaining in the season.

text: La marina militàri dê Stati Unìti rissi ca stava indagànnu supra zoccu successi.
text_en: The US Navy also said they were investigating the incident.

text: Ntâ na dichiaraziòni affirmarunu macàri, “l’equipaggio sta travagghiànnu p’attruvàri la megghiu manèra di estrarri la navi in sicurèzza”.
text_en: They also said in a statement, "The crew is currently working to determine the best method of safely extracting the ship".

text: Na cacciamina di classi Avenger, la navi stava iennu a Puerto Princesa, Palawan.
text_en: An Avenger class mine countermeasures ship, the ship was on its way to Puerto Princesa in Palawan.

text: È assignata â settima flotta dâ marina militàri dê Stati Uniti, e s’attrova a Sasebo, Nagasaki, ntô Giappuni.
text_en: It is assigned to the U.S. Navy’s Seventh Fleet and based in Sasebo, Nagasaki in Japan.

text: L’aggressùri di Mumbai arrivàrunu via navi lu 26 novembri 2008, puttannusi arrèri granade, armi automatiche e culpirono diversi bersagli, tra cui la stazziòni ferroviària di Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus e l’ ammuntuatu Taj Mahal Hotel.
text_en: The Mumbai attackers arrived via boat on Novemeber 26, 2008, bringing with them grenades, automatic weapons and hit multiple targets including the crowded Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus railway station and the famous Taj Mahal Hotel.

text: La ricerca e la raccolta d’informazioni di David Headley contribuì a attuàri l’operazioni dê 10 cristiàni armàti dô gruppu di militanti pakistànu Laskhar-e-Taiba.
text_en: David Headley's scouting and information gathering had helped to enable the operation by the 10 gunmen from the Pakistani militant group Laskhar-e-Taiba.

text: L’attaccu misi a dura prova la relaziàni ‘ntra India e Pakistan.
text_en: The attack put a huge strain on relations between India and Pakistan.

text: Accumpagnatu ri chisti funziunari, assicuràu li cittadini rû Texas ca stàvanu pigghiannu li misuri pi prutèggiri la sicurizza pùbblica.
text_en: Accompanied by those officials, he assured Texas citizens that steps were being taken to protect the public's safety.

text: In particulari Perry risse: “Ci sunnu pochi puosti ntô munnu pi affruntari li sfidi ri chistu casu.”
text_en: Perry specifically said, "There are few places in the world better equipped to meet the challenge that is posed in this case."

text: Lu guvirnaturi affirmàu puru: “Oggi scupremmu ca certi picciriḍḍi ri l’età ri scola àppiru quarchi cuntattu ccu lu paziente.”
text_en: The governor also stated, "Today, we learned that some school aged children have been identified as having had contact with the patient."

text: Cuntinuàu a diri “Chistu casu è sèriu. Stati tranquilli ca lu nostru sistema sta funziunannu comu avìa a èssiri.”
text_en: He went on to say, "This case is serious. Rest assured that our system is working as well as it should."

text: Si cunfirmatu, la scuperta chiue la circata di ottu anni d’Allen pî Musashi.
text_en: If confirmed, the find completes Allen's eight-year search for the Musashi.

text: Leslie Aun, na purtavuci dâ Funnaziune Komen, dissi ca l’organizzaziòni aduttàu na nova règula ca nun pirmetti di dari nu prèmiu in finanziamenti o funni ca sunnu sutta indàggini ligali.
text_en: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text: La pulìtica di Komen squalificàu Planned Parenthood a causa di n'indàggini 'n cursu pi vìdiri comu Planned Parenthood spenni e duna cuntu dî spisi. Lu capu di l'invistigazzioni è lu rapprisintanti Cliff Stearns.
text_en: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: Stearns sta indagannu si li tassi sunnu usati pi finanziari l’aborti attraversu Planned Parenthood ntô so rolu di capu dû Suttacomitatu dâ Supervisiuni e dî Ndaggini, ca è sutta la protezziòni dâ Cummissiuni di l’Energia e lu Cummèrciu dâ Camera.
text_en: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: Lu precedènti guvirnatùri dû Massachusetts Mitt Romney vincìu l’elezziòni prisidinziali primari dû Partitu ripubblicanu dâ Florida martiddì cu cchiù dô 46 pircentu dê voti.
text_en: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text: Lu precedènti rilatùri statunitenzi dâ Camera Newt Gingrich arruvàu secùnnu ccô 32 pircentu.
text_en: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text: Comu statu dâ vincita assuluta, la Florida desi tutti li cinquanti diligati a Romney, spincennulu avanti comu cannidatu pâ nomina dû partitu Ripubblicanu.
text_en: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: L’organizzaturi dâ prutesta dissuru ca circa 100.000 pirsuna arruvàrunu ntê città tidìschi comu Berlinu, Colònia, Amburgu e Hannover.
text_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: A Berlinu, la polizzìa cuntàu 6.500 o nta di ḍḍocu cristiani ca prutistàvunu.
text_en: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text: Li prutesti ci fùrunu puru a Pariggi, Sofia (Bulgarìa), Vilnius (Lìtuania), La Valletta (Malta), Tallin (Estonia), Edimburgu e Glasgow (Scozia).
text_en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: A Londra quasi 200 cristiani prutistàrunu fora l’uffici dê granni amministraturi dê diritti di copyright (proprietà 'ntillittuali).
text_en: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: Lu misi passatu ci foru prutesti granni nna Polònia. Lu Paisi vinìa di singari l’ACTA, ca purtàu lu guvernu a dicìdiri di nun validari l’accordu, almenu pi com'ora.
text_en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: La Littonia e la Slovacchia arritardaru a juncìrisi ccu l’ACTA.
text_en: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: La Libbirazziòni Armali e la Società Riali pâ Privinzioni dâ Crudeltà sull’Armali (RSPCA) stannu chidennu n’autra vota li telecàmiri di sicurizza ntâ tutti li mattatòi australiani.
text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: Lu ispetturi capu dû New South Wales RSPCA David O'Shannessy dissi all’ABC câ sorviglianza e l’ispeziòni dî mattatoi avirrìanu a èssiri cumuni ntâ l’Austràlia.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: “Li telecàmiri certamenti mannirìunu nu signali forti a ḍḍi pirsuna ca travàgghiunu cu l’armali cu so benèssiri è la priurità cchiù àuta.”
text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: La carta internazziunali dê tirrimoti fatta dû Sundaggiu Geologgicu dê Stati Uniti (United States Geological Survey) nun signalava tirrimoti in Islanda pi tutta la simana 'nnanzi.
text_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Videmma, l’istitutu meterològgicu islandisi nun avìa signalatu nuḍḍa attivitàti di tirrimoti ntâ l’àrea dû vurcanu Hekla ntê 48 uri annanzi.
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: La ‘mpurtanti attività di tirrimoti ca purtàu ô canciamentu di fasi ammattìu lu 10 marzu ntô latu Nord-est dâ caldera ntô pizzu dû vurcanu.
text_en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Signalaru la prisenza di nuvula nìuri, nnipinnentidi l'attività vurcànica, ê pedi dâ muntagna.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Li nùvula criaru cunfusioni pì capiri si cc’avìa statu di veru n' eruzzioni.
text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Lu Luno avìa 120-160 metri cubbi di carburanti a bordu quannu si rumpìù e li venti àuti e l’unnati lu spincèru contru la diga.
text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: L’elicotteri sarvàrunu li dudici mèmbri di l’equipàggiu e l’unica firìta fu nu nasu ruttu.
text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: La navi di 100 metri stava iennu a pigghiari lu sòlitu càricu di cuncimi e a princìpiu a li funziunari ci vinni lu scantu ca na parti di lu caricu si putìa perdiri.
text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: La mudifica proposta già passàu dî du cameri ntô 2011.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Nu canciamentu fu fattu ntâ sessioni liggislativa quannu la sicunna sintenza fu cancillata prima dâ Camera dî rapprisintanti e poi fu passata ntâ nu furmatu simili ô Sinatu luniddì.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Lu fallimèntu dâ sicunna sintenza, ca prupuni di abbuliri l’unioni civili cu stissu sessu, putrìa àpriri la potta di l’unioni civìli ntô futùru.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Siguennu lu prucessu, lu HJR-3 sarà rividùtu ntâ prossima liggislazziuni eletta ntô 2015 o lu 2016 pi ristari ntô procèssu.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: L’obbiettivi di Vautier fora dâ dirizziuni includunu nu sciòpiru dâ fami ntô 1973 contru chiḍḍu ca ci parìa na censura pulìtica.
text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: La liggi francisi fu canciata. Lu so attivismu turnàu a quannu avìa 15 anni quannu s’unìu â Risistinza francisi duranti la secunna guerra mundiali.
text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Parràu di iḍḍu stissu nna nu libbru dû 1998.
text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Nna l’anni Sissanta, turnàu nna l’Algeria ca era innipinnenti pi ‘nzignari riggìa.
text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Lu judoka giappunisi Hitoshi Saito, vincitùri di du midagghi d’òru ntâ l’Olimpiadi, murìu a 54 anni.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: La càusa dâ morti fu annunciata comu cancru ô dottu biliari intraepàticu.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Murìu a Osaka martiddì.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Ortri ca ex campiuni mundiali e olìmpicu, Saito era lu diritturi dâ cummissioni d’addestramentu dâ Federazzioni di Judo di tuttu lu Giappuni finu a quannu murìu.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Almenu 100 pirsuna patticipàrunu â festa, pi celebbrari lu primu anniversàriu di na coppia ca si spusàu l’annu scorsu.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Lu persunali dissi ca fu organizzatu n’evèntu fummali pi l’anniversàriu nna n’autra data.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: La cucchia s’avìa maritatu ntô Texas oggi è l'annu, e vinni a Buffalo pi celebbrari ccu l’amici e li parenti.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Lu maritu di 30 anni, natu a Buffalo, era unu dî quattru ammazzati ntâ sparatòria, ma so mugghièri nun fu firita.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno è nu tutor ingrisi abbanniatu ma contruversu ca insignava Educazzioni muderna e Gloria dô Re ca affirmava di avìri 9000 studenti ntô piccu dâ so carriera.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Ntê so appunti usava palori ca quarchi ginituri cunsidirava vulgari, e dìcunu ca dicìa uscinità ntâ classi.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Educazzioni muderna (Modern Education) lu accusàu di stampari pubblicità granni nna l’autubbùssi senza autorizzaziuni e imbrugghiava dicennu ca era lu tutor capu ingrisi.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Fu accusatu puru di violazziuni dû copyright, ma nun fu imputatu.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Nu vècchiu studenti dissi ca “usava lu slang ntâ classi, nsignava tràmiti appunti commu fari la curti e facìa l’amicu dê studenti.”
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Duranti l’ultimi tri decenni, puru si ufficialmènti ristàu nu statu cumunista, la Cina sviluppàu na economìa di mircatu.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Li primi rifòrmi economichi foru fatti sutta u cumannu di Deng Xiaoping.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Di tannu, li diminsiùna econòmici dâ Cina criscèru 90 voti.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Pâ prima vota, l’annu scorsu la Cina espurtàu cchiù màchini dâ Girmania e surpassàu li Stati Uniti comu mircatu cchiù granni pi chista indùstria.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Lu PIL dâ Cina putissi addivintari cchiù àutu dê Stati Uniti entru du' decenni.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: La timpesta trupicali Danielle, la quarta timpesta chiamata dâ staggiuni di l’uragani atlàntici dû 2010, si furmàu nna l’ocèanu Atlànticu urientali.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: La timpesta, situata approssimativamenti a 3.000 mìgghia di Miami, ntâ Florida, àvi massimi venti sustinuti di 40 mph (64 kph).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Li scinziati ntô Centru nazziunali di l’uragani prividunu ca Danielle diventa cchiù forti addivintannu n’uraganu entru mercuriddì.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Puru si la timpesta è luntana di l’approdu, resta difficili valutari lu ‘mpattu putinziali ntê Stati Uniti o ntê Caraibbi.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Bobek nascìu ntâ capitali cruata, Zagàbria, e addivintàu ammuntuatu jucannu pû Partizan Belgradu.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: S’unìu ntô 1945 e arristàu nsinu ô 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Duranti lu so tempu câ squatra, signàu 403 gol ntâ 468 cumparsi.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Nuḍḍu avìa fattu cchiù prisenzi o signatu cchiù golli pâ squatra di Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Ntô 1995 fu numinatu lu megghiu jucatùri dâ storia dû Partizan.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Li festeggiamènti cuminciàrunu cu nu spittàculu spiciali dû gruppu abbanniatu ntô munnu Cirque du Soleil.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Siguìu l’orchestra sinfònica dû Statu israelianu, nu gruppu Janissary e li cantanti Fatih Erkoç e Müslüm Gürses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Poi li Whirling Dervishes acchianàrunu ntô palcu.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: La diva turca Sezen Aksu s’esibìu ccô tinùri italianu Alessandru Safina e lu cantanti grecu Haris Alexiou.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Pi finìri, lu gruppu turcu di danza Fire of Anatolia fici lu spittaculu “Troy”.
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, nu pilota di motu di 13 anni, murìu dopu ca fici parti di nu incidenti nna l’Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Mentri ca facìa nu giru di prova, Lenz cadìu dâ motu e fu colpitu di l’àutru pilota Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Fu ‘mmidiatamenti succurrùtu dô staff medicu supra la pista e traspurtatu nna nu spitali lucali unni poi murìu.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat non fu firutu nna l’incidènti.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Pi la situazzioni finanziària cumplissiva, Zapatero cuntinàu dicennu ca “lu sistema finanziàriu è parti di l’economìa, na parti cruciali.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Avemu na crisi finanziària ca àvi n’annu, ca appi lu momentu cchiù acutu nna l’ultimi du misi, e ora pensu chî mircati finanziari stannu cuminciannu a ripigghiàrisi.”
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: La simana scorsa, Naked News annunciàu c’aumenterà assài lu so mannàtu linguìsticu internazziunali pâ informaziòni, cu tri novi canali.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: L’organizzazziuni globali, ca dava già li nutizi in ingrìsi e giappunìsi, sta lanciannu lu spagnolu, l’italianu e li programmi ntâ lingua coreana, pâ televisiòni, l’internet e li dispusitivi mòbbili.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Pì furtuna non mi succidìu nenti, ma vidìa na scina màcabra mentri ca li pirsuna ciccaunu di rùmpiri li finestri pi nèsciri.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Li genti culpìunu li vitri cchî seggi, ma li vitri èrunu infrangìbbili.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: “Unu dî vitri â fini si rumpìu e cuminciàrunu a nèsciri dâ finestra,” dissi lu supravvissutu Franciszek Kowal.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Li stiḍḍi emànunu luci e caudu a causa di l’energìa ginirata quannu l’àtumi di idròggenu si fùnnunu insèmmula pi furmari elementi cchiù pisanti.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Li scinziati stanu travagghiànnu pi criàri nu riatturi ca po fari enirgìa ntâ stissa manèra.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Chistu, comunqui, è nu probblema assài difficili di risòlviri e ci vurrannu tant’anni prima di vidiri costruiti li riatturi di fusioni ùtili.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: L’agu d’ azzàru gallìggia supra l’acqua a causa dâ tinsiòni dâ superfìci.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: La tinsiuni dâ superfìci si virifica picchì li muleculi d’acqua ntâ superficî di l’acqua sunnu assài attratti l’una cu l’autra cchiù di quantu sunnu attratti dî muleculi d’aria supra.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Li moleculi d’acqua crìunu na peddi invisibbili ntâ superficî di l’acqua ca fa accadiri cosi comu l’agu ca galliggia supra l’acqua.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: A lama nna nu pàttinu pû ghiàcciu muderni ha nu bordu dòppiu cu na cavità concava ntô mienzu. Li du bordi hannu na mègghiu presa dû ghiàcciu, puru inclinati.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Siccomu lu funnu dâ lama è liggirmenti curvatu, quannu la lama s’inclina nna nu latu o l’àutru, lu bordu ca è nu contattu cû ghiàcciu si curva puru.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Chistu fa furrìari lu pattinatùri. Si li pattini s’inclinunu a destra, lu pattinatùri furrìa a destra, si li pattini s’inclinunu a manca, lu pattinatùri furrìa a manca.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Pì turnari ô pricidenti livellu d’energia, s’hannu libbiràri di l’energia extra ca pigghiaru dâ luci.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Lu fannu emittennu na particeḍḍa nica di luci chiamata “futuni”.
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Li scinziati chiàmunu chistu prucessu “emissiuni stimulata di radiazziuni” picchì l’àtumi sunnu stimulati dâ luci forti, ca causa l’emissiuni di nu futuni di luci, e la luci è nu tipu di radiazziuni.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: La pròssima immàggini mostra l’atumi ca emettunu futùni. Ovviamenti, ntâ rialità li futuni sunnu assài cchiù nichi di chiḍḍi nna l’immàggini.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Li futuni sunnu puru cchiù nichi dâ robba ca componi l’àtumi!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Doppu cintinaia d’uri di funziunamèntu, lu filamentu ntâ lampadina si squagghia e la lampadìna nun funziona cchiù.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: La lampadìna s’avìa a canciàri. S’havi a stari attenti quannu si cancia na lampadìna.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Primu, lu ‘ntirruttùri dâ luci hava essiri stutatu o lu cavu staccàtu.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Chistu picchì l’elettrcità ca scurri ntâ presa unni si trova la parti metallica dâ lampadina pò dari na forti scossa elettrica si tocchi la parti nterna dâ presa o lu mitallu ntâ basi dâ lampadina mentri è ancòra ‘n parti intra a presa.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: L’organu principàli dû sistema cicculatoriu è lu cori, ca spinci lu sàngu.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Lu sangu si ni va dû cori nna dî tubbi chiamati arteri e torna ntô cori ntê tubbi chiamati vini. Li tubbi cchiù stritti sunnu li capillari.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Li denti rû triceràtopo putìanu scacciari un sulu i fogghi, ma puru i rami assài duri e i rariche.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Quarchi scinziatu piensa ca i triceràtopi manciàvanu i cicadi, ca sunnu nu tipu ri pianta ca era cumuni ntô Critàciu.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Sti pianti assumìgghianu a n’àrvuru ri parma cu na curuna ri fògghi fini e ammulati.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Nu triceràtopo putìa usari u so beccu forti pi livari i fogghi prima ri manciàrisi u truncu.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Àvutri scinziati rìciunu ca sti pianti ieranu assài vilinusi, picciò è improbàbbili ca i dinosàuri s’î manciàrunu, puru siddu oggi u bràdipu e àvutri armali comu u pappajaddu (nu discindenti rî dinosàuri) ponnu manciari fogghi e frutti vilinusi.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Comu facissi la forza di gravità di Io pi tiràrimi? Siḍḍu tu fussi supra la superfici dû Io, pisassi cchiù picca di quantu pisi supra la Terra.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Nu cristianu ca pìsa 200 libbri (90 chilu) supra ra Terra, putissi pisari circa 36 libbri (16 chilu) supra a Io. Picciò a gravità, sicuramenti, attira cchiu picca.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: U Suli unnavi a crusta comu a Terra runni tu stai. Tuttu u Suli è fattu ri gas, focu e plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Lu gas addiventa cchiù suttili manu manu ca t’alluntani ru centru ru Suli.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: A parti ri fuora ca viriemu quannu taliamu u Suli si chiama fotùsfera, ca voli riri “baḍḍa ri luci”.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Circa trimila anni doppu, ni l’annu 1610, l‘astrònomu Galilèu Galilèi usàu nu telescòpiu pi bbirii ca Vèniri avi li fasi comu l’avi a Luna.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Ci sunnu li fasi picchì sulu a facci ri Viniri (o râ Luna) ca s’affàccia ntô Suli è illuminata. I fasi ri Viniri aiutàrunu a tiurìa ri Cupirnicu ca i pianiti gìranu ‘ntornu u Suli.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Ri poi, quarche annu roppu, ni l’annu 1639, n’astrònumu ingrisi chiamatu Jeremìah Horrocks vitte nu passaggiu ri Vèniri.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Li ngrisi avìanu avutu un pirìudu di paci longu doppu ca avìanu ricunquistatu lu Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Nentidimenu, ntô 991, Ethelred vinni affruntatu di na flotta vichinga cchiù rossa di chiḍḍa di Gunthrum, cent’anni arreri.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Chista flotta era cumannata dô nurviggisi Olaf Trygvasson, ca vulìa arripigghiàrisi lu so paisi livànnulu di la duminazzioni danisi.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Doppu ca scunfitti militari lu fìciru piniari di principiu, Ethelred accittàu l'accordu cu Olaf, ca partìu pâ Nurveggia pi tintari di pigghiàrisi lu so regnu, cu un pocu di mala sorti.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: L' hangeul è lu sulu alfabbetu mmintatu pi usu pupulari quotidianu. L’ alfabbetu fu mmintatu ntô 1444 nnô regnu dû re Sejong (1418 - 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Re Sejonf fu u quartu re râ dinastìa Joseon e è unu rî cchiù apprizzati.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Origginariamenti iddu avìa chiamatu l’alfabbetu Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, ca voli riri “i soni giusti pi iducari i genti”.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Ci sunnu assài tiurìi ri comu nascìu lu sanscrittu. Una parra ri na migrazzione ariana ri l’òvist ra l’Innia ca si purtàu a so lingua.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Lu sanscrittu è na lìngua antica e si po paragunari â lìngua latina parrata nta l’Europa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Lu libbru cchiù anticu canusciutu fu scrivutu nto sanscrittu. Doppu a scrittura ri l’Upanishad, lu sanscrittu scumparìu pi càusa ri girarchìa.
