text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Lu sanscrittu è na lìngua assài cumplessa e ricca, ca fu la funti di tanti lìngue inniani, pròpiu comu lu latinu fu la funti dê lingue europee comu lu francisi e lu spagnuolu.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Ccâ fini râ battàgghia pâ Frància, a Girmània accuminciò a priparàrisi pi immàdiri l’ìsula râ Gran Britagna.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: A Girmània chiamàu in codici l’attaccu “Opirazzioni Liuni marinu”. A maggiuranza ri l’armi pisanti e ri scuorte ri l’isircitu britànnicu si pirderu quannu si nni nisciu ri Dunkirk, picciò l’isircitu era abbastanza dèbbuli.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ma a Marina Riali era ancuora assài cchiù fuorti râ Marina tidisca (a “Kriegsmarine”) e avìa pututu distrùggiri tutti i navi ri l’invasiuni mannati ntô Canali ingrisi.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: In tutti li casi, ieranu picca assài i navi râ Marina riali ca si truvàvanu vicinu i vìi probàbbili pi l’invasiuni picchì l’ammiragghi si scantàvunu ca l’attacchi aèrii tidischi i putianu affunnari.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Accuminciamu cu na spiegazzioni dî piani di l’Itàlia. L’Itàlia era suprattuttu lu “fratri nicu” dâ Girmània e dû Giappuni.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Avìa n’esèrcitu cchiù dèbbuli e na marina cchiù dèbbuli, puru siḍḍu avìa giustu custruitu quattru navi novi prima dû principiu dâ guerra.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: L’obbittivi principali ri l’Italia èranu i paisi africani. Pi pigghiarisi sti paisi, ci sirbìa na piattaforma ri lànciu pi truppi, ca i truppi putìssiru navigari nto Mari Miditirràniu e invàdiri l’Africa.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Pi chistu, s'avìanu a libbirari ri basi e ri navi ingrisi nto Eggittu. Apparti sti azzioni, i navi ri battàgghia italiani unnavianu a fari àvutru.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Ora, û Giappuni. U Giappuni era na nazziuni insulare, comu a Gran Britàgna.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: I suttamarini sunnu navi pinzati pi viaggiari sutta l’acqua, e stannu ḍḍà suttu assài tiempu.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: I suttamarini foru usati ntâ prima e ntâ sicunna guerra munniali. A ddu tiempu èranu assài lìenti e avìanu na ittata assài curta.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Ntô princìpiu râ guerra viaggiàvanu suprattuttu ntâ superfici ri l’acqua, ma quannu si svilupparunu i radar e addivintarunu cchiù pricisi, i suttamarini furunu custrinciuti a gghiri sutta l’acqua pi un èssiri viruti.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Li suttamarini tidischi ièranu chiamati U-Boats. I tidischi ièrunu assài bravi a navigari e purtari i so suttamarini.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Grazzi ô successu chî suttamarini, doppu la guerra nun si criri ca li tidischi n’avìssiru assài.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Sì! U re Tutankhamun, quarchi bota chiamàtu “Re Tut” oppuru “U re Picciutteddu”, è unu rî cchiù canusciùti ri l’eggizzi oggi.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Na cosa intirissanti è ca iḍḍu un era cunsidiratu assài impurtanti nta l’antichità e unn s’attrova ntâ tanti listi ri re antichi.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Comunqui, la scuperta dâ so sipurtura ntô 1922 lu fici addivintari na cilibrità. Assài sipultùri dû passatu foru arrubbati, ma chista sipurtura nun fu praticamenti tuccata.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: La majurìa dî cuosi sipurti cu Tutankhamun si sarbaru beni, puru migghiàia di cuosi fatti cu mitalli prizziusi e petri rari.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Grazzi a l’inbinzione ri ròti ccu raggi, i carri assiri èrunu cchiù liggeri, ràpidi e megghiu priparati pi ghiri chiù fuorti ri surdati e ri àvutri carri.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: I frecci rî so archi murtali putìanu tràsiri rintra l’ammatura rî surdati nimici. Circa nta l’annu 1000 A.C., l’Assiri inbintàrunu a prima cavallirìa.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: La cavallirìa è n'esèrcitu ca cummatti assittatu supra li cavaḍḍi. La seḍḍa nun avìa statu nvintata ancora, pirciò la cavallirìa di l'Assiria cummattìa assittata supra la carina nuda dî cavaḍḍi.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Canuscemu assài pulìtici, scinziati e artisti grechi. Capaci câ pirsuna cchiù canusciuta di chista curtura è Omeru, lu ligginnariu pueta orbu ca scrivìu dui òpiri dâ littiratura greca: i puemi Iliadi e Odissèa.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sòfocle e Aristòfane sunnu ancuora drammaturghi ammuntuati e i so cummedi sunnu cunsidirati tra l’òpiri cchiù impurtanti râ littiratura munniale.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: N’autru matimàticu grecu ammuntuatu è Pitàgura, canusciutu suprattuttu pî so tiuremi supra li rilazzioni dî lati dû triàngulu rittàngulu.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Ci sunnu vari stimi di quanti genti pàrranu u hindi. Si piensa ca è tra a secunna e a quarta lingua cchiù comunimenti parrata ntô munnu.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: U nùmmuru di parranti nativi vària a secunna di quanti sunnu misi nto cuntu i dialetti tra di issi assài liati.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: I stimi vannu di 340 miliuna a 500 miliuna di parranti, e pillumènu 800 miluna di gienti capìsciunu a lingua.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi e urdu hannu palori sìmili ma scritti diversamenti; ntê cunversazioni quotidiani, li parlanti dê dui lìngui di sòlitu si capìsciunu.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: All’incirca ntô sèculu quinniciesimu, u nord di l’Istònia s’attrvò sutta a influenza curturali dâ Girmània.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Quarchi mònacu tidiscu vulìa abbicinari u Signuri â genti nativa, picciò si inbintàrunu a lìngua littirali ra Istonia.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Era basata supra l’arfabbetu tidiscu e ci fu agghiunciuta na littra “Õ/õ”.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Ntô cursu rû tiempu, assài palore pigghiati rû tidiscu si funnièrunu. Fu l princìpiu rû lluminìsmu.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: A tradizzioni voli ca l’eredi ô tronu avia a trasiri rittu rittu nta l’esèrcitu roppu a scola.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: A ogni modu, Carlo si nni ìu ô Trinity College, a Cambridge, unni studiàu antropoluggìa e archioluggìa, e cchiù tardi a stòria, e pigghiàu nu 2:2 (nu diploma menu impurtanti ra secunna classi).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Carlo fu u primu membru râ fammìgghia riali ingrisi a pigghiàrisi nu diploma.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: A Turchìa europèa (Tràcia urientali o Rumèlia ntâ pinìsula balcànica) avi u 3% rû paìsi.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: U tirritòriu râ Turchìa è cchiù longu ri 1600 chilòmetri (1000 mìgghia) e largu 800 chilòmetri (500 mìgghia), ccu na forma quasi rittàngulari.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: A zona râ Turchìa, ccu i laghi, si pigghia 783.562 chilòmetri quatri (300.948 mìgghia quatri), e ri chisti 755.688 chilòmetri quatri (291.773 mìgghia quatri) sunnu ntô sud òvist ri l’Àsia e 23.764 chilòmetri quatri (9174 mìgghia quatri) su nta Europa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Grazzi â so ària, a Turchìa è a 37ma nazzione cchiù granni dû munnu, è comu a grannizza râ Frància e dû Regnu Unitu metropolitani insemmula.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: La Turchìa è circunnata dû mari di tri banni: lu Mari Eggèu a òvest, lu Mari Nìuru a nord e lu Mari Miditirraniu ô sud.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: U Lussimburgu àvi na stòria longa, ma a so innipinnenza accuminciàu ntô 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Parti odierni rû Bèlgiu facìanu parti rû Lussimburgu na vota, ma addivintarunu belgi doppu a rivoluzione belga ri l’anni ru 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: U Lussimburgu circàu sempri ri ristari na nazziuni neutrale, ma fu accupatu nta tutti i rue guerre munniali dâ Girmània.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Ntô 1957 u Lussimburgu addivintò membru funnaturi ri l’organizzazziuni ca oggi si chiama Unione Europèa.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: U Drukgyal Dzong è na furtizza in ruina e nu munasteru buddista ntâ parti supiriuri rû distrittu Paro (ntô villàggiu Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Si dici ca ntô 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel criò la furtizza pi ricurdari la so vittoria supra li forzi tibbitanu-mònguli.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Ntô 1951, n’incèndiu fici ristari sulu pochi ruini rû Drukgyal Dzong, comu l'immàggini rû Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Doppu l’incinniu, a furtizza fu sàrbata e prutiggiuta, e riesta una ri l’attrazziuni ri Bhutan cchiù sinsazziunali.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Ntô XVIII sèculu, a Camboggia s’attruvò scacciata tra rue vicini putenti, a Tailandia e u Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: I tailannisi invarìrunu a Camboggia assài voti ntô XVIII sèculu e ntô 1772 distruggìrunu Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Nta l’urtimi anni dû XVIII sèculu i vietnamisi invarirunu puru a Cambòggia.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: U riciottu pircentu rî vinizzuelani sunnu risoccupati, e a maggiuranza rî l’occupati travàgghia nta l’iconumìa cunnè ligali.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Ru terzi rî vinizzuelani ca travàgghianu sunnu ntô sitturi tirziàriu, quasi nu quartu travàgghia nta l’indùstria e nu quintu travàgghia nta l’agricultura.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Na ndustria mpurtanti pî venezzuelani è chiḍḍa dû pitroliu, lu paisi è un esportaturi nettu, puru si sulu l’unu pi centu travagghia ntâ ndustria dû pitroliu.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Ntô principiu dâ nnipinnenza dâ nazziuni, ccâ cumpitenza dî Jardini butànici di Singapuri aiutàu a trasfurmari l’ìsula nna na città iardinu trupicali.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Ntô 1981, a Vanda Miss Joaquim, n’orchidèa ìbbrida, fu scigghiuta comu ciuru nazzionali.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Ogni annu ntô misi ri ottobri quasi 1,5 miliuna ri erbìvuri viàggianu versu i chiani rû sud, attravirsannu lu ciumi Mara, ru latu nord pi pioggi.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: E poi n'autra vota pû nord traversu l’òvest, travirsannu n'autra vota lu ciumi e poi n'autra vota lu Mara, doppu l' àcqui dô misi d' aprili all’incirca.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: A riggiuni rû Serengeti cuntèni u parcu nazziunàli ri Serengeti, a zzona ri tutela Ngorongoro e a Riserva ri caccia Maswa na Tanzania e a Riserva nazziunàli Maasai nto Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Oi imparàri a criàri cuntinuti multimediali interattivi ci vole abbilità cunvenzionali e tradizzionali, ma puru strumenti ca si canusciunu sturianno ntê classi interattivi (buzzetti, muntaggiu àudiu e vìdiu, narrazziuni, ecc.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: U prugettu intirattivu voli ca tu valuti i to canuscenzi pa produzzioni ri midia e t’impari a pinsari nta na manera non liniari.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: U prugettu intirattivu voli ca li cumpunenti rû proggettu si lìanu l’unu cu l’àvutru, ma hannu aviri sensu puru comu cuose siparati.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: U svantàggiu ri lenti pû zoom è ca cumplessità focàli e lu nùmmaru ri l’elementi ri lenti ca serbonu p’arrivàri a na seri ri lunghizzi focali è cchiù àvutu ri chiddu pi l’obbiettìvi focali.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Chistu sta addivintannu nu probblema cchiù nicu picchì i produtturi rî lenti arrìvunu a standard cchiù àuti ntâ produzzioni ri lenti.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Chistu pirmittìu ê lenti pû zoom ri criàri immàggini ri na qualità comu chiḍḍa ri lenti ca lunghìzza focàli fissa.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: N’àutru svantàggiu dî lenti pû zoom è ca l’apirtura màssima (la vilocità) dî lenti di sòlitu è cchiù bàscia.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Chistu renne ca li lenti econòmici pû zoom sunnu diffìcili di usari ntê cunnizzioni di luci vasci senza lu flash.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Unu dî probblemi cchiù fàcili di ncuntrari quannu si voli cunvèrtiri 'n film ntô furmatu DVD è l’overscan (suprascanziuni).
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Quasi tutti li tilivisioni sunu fatti pi cumpiacìri lu pùbblicu.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Pi chistu mutivu, tuttu chiḍḍu chi si vidi ntâ tilevisioni avi li burda tagghiati,in capu, funnu e lati.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Chistu pi èssiri sicuri ca a mmàggini cummogghia tuttu lu schermu. Na lingua ngrisi si chiama overscan (suprascanziuni).
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Dispiaci ca quannu si fa un DVD, capaci ca puru li burda su' tagghiati, e si lu vidiu àvi li suttatìtuli troppu vicini ô funnu dû discu, nun si vìdinu sani.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: P' àssai tempu lu casteḍḍu midievali tradizziunali aḍḍuma la criatività, e fa pinzari â ‘mmàgini di cummattimenti, tavulati e dî cavaleri dô re Artù.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Puru ora, stannu fermi ntô menzu dî ruvìni vecchi di mill’anni si ponu quasi arricurdari li sona e li ciàuri di l’antichi battagghi, e quasi quasi si senti lu scrùsciu dî zòcculi supra li petri e si ciaurìa lu scantu ca vinìa di suttaterra.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Allura, la nostra fantasìa veni dâ realità? Pirchì s'accuminciaru a custruiri li casteḍḍi? Comu foru prugittati e custruiti?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Tipicu di ḍḍù pirìudu, u castèḍḍu Kirby Muxloe è cchiù na casa furtificata ca nu vieru castiḍḍu.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: I so finistri a granni vitrati e i mura fini un navìunu pututu risìstiri assài a n’attaccu dicisu.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Ntô 1480, quannu lord Hastings accuminciò a costruiri, a nazziuni vivìa nu pirìudu ri paci rilativa e s’avìanu a difènniri sulu contra cricchi nichi ri latruni senza na casa.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: L’equilìbbriu ri putiri era nu sistema unni i nazziuni europèe circàvanu ri mantiniri u dumìniu nazziunali ri tutti i stati europèi.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: U cuncettu era ca tutti i nazziuni europèe avìanu a circari ri scanziari ca na nazziuni addivintassi troppu putenti, picciò i guverni nazziunali spissu canciàvanu allianzi pi mantiniri l’equilìbbriu.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: A Guerra ri succissioni spagnuola signò a prima uerra c’avìa nu probblema cintrali ri equilìbbriu ri putiri.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Chistu fu nu canciamentu mpurtanti, picchì li putiri europèi nun putìanu cchiù aviri la scusa di guerri di riliggiuni. Picciò, la Guerra dî trint’anni fu l’urtima guerra difinita di riliggiuni.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: U tèmpiu ri Artèmidi a Èfesu fu distruggiutu u 21 di giugno rû 356 a.C. cû n’attu ri piromanìa fattu ri Erostratu.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Secunnu a stòria, iḍḍu vulìa a fama pi forza. L’Efesini, offisi, riciriru ca u nomu ri Erostratu un avìa a issiri mai rigistratu.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: U stòricu grecu Strabbuni cchiù avanti scrivìu u nomu, pi chistu oggi u canuscemu. U tèmpiu fu distruggiutu a sira stissa ca nascìu Lissandru u Ranni.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Lissandru, comu re, offrìu ri paari pi ricustruiri u tèmpiu, ma a so ufferta non fu accittata. Poi, dopu ca Lissandru murìu, fu ricustruitu u tèmpiu ntô 323 a.C.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Assicùriti ca a to manu è cchiù rilassata possìbbili mentri ca spinci i noti curretti, e cerca puru run fari troppi movimenti stranìi chi ti irita.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Ri chista manera, ti stanchi lu menu possìbbili. Ricorda ca un serbe spìnciri i tasti ccu tanta forza p’aviri nu vulumi cchiù forti comu succere cu pianuforti.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Ntâ fisarmonica, p’aviri cchiù vulumi, s’usanu i suffietti ccu cchiù prissioni o vilocità.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Lu misticismu è la ricerca di cumunioni, identità, o cunsapivulizza cuscienti ccu na rialità difinitiva, divinitati, viritati spirituali o Diu.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: U fideli cerca na spiriènzia diretta, na intuizzioni o cumprensioni rintra a rialità divina/a divinità o i divinità..
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: I siguaci cercanu certi manèri ri vìviri, o pratichi ca serbunu pi nutricari chisti spirànzi.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: U misticismu può èssiri distintu ri l’àutri formi di crirènza e vinirazziuni religgiusa pâ so ènfasi supra a spiriènzia pirsunali diretta di n’ùnicu statu di cunsapivulizza, suprattuttu chiḍḍi di nu pirsunàggiu pacìficu, prufunnu, filici e puru estàticu.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: U sikhismu è na riliggiuni rû subcuntinenti innianu. Nascìu ntâ riggiuni rû Punjàb duranti u 15mu siculu râ divisioni ri na setta râ tradizzioni Hindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Li sikh pènsanu ca la so riliggiuni è separata di l’Innuismu puru siddu arricanusciunu li so ràriga e tradizzioni hindu.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: I sikh chiàmanu a so riliggiuni Gurmat, ca nto Punjabi voli riri “strata rû guru”. U guru è u spettu funnamintali ri tutti i riliggiuni inniani, ma ntô sikhismu avi na 'mpurtanza ca forma u nùcliu ri cririenzi sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: A riliggiuni fu funnata ntô 15mu siculu dû guru Nanak (1469-1539). Doppu iḍḍu ci foru àvutri novi guru.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Comunqui, ntô giugnu ru 1956, li prumissi ri Krushcev foru misi â prova quannu i manifestazzioni nta Pulònia, unni i lavuraturi prutistàvunu contru â caristìa ri manciari e i tagghi ri stipendi, si trasfurmarunu nta na prutiesta ginirali contra u Cumunismu.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Puru siddu Krushchev ntô finiri mannò i carrarmati pi ricupirari a situazzioni, accittò na pocu ri dumanni acunòmichi e ri numinari Wladyslaw Gomulka, ch'avìa addivintatu ammuntuatu, comu novu primu ministru.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: A civilizzazioni râ valle ri l’Indo fu na civilizzazioni ri l’età rû bronzu ntô nord ovist rû subcontinenti innianu ca pigghiava a maggiuranza rû Pàkistan mudernu e quarchi riggiuni ntô nord ovist ri l’Innia e rû nord est ri l’Afghànistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: La civiltà ciurìu ntô bacinu dû ciumi Indu di unni veni lu so nomu.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Puru si cierti scinziati crìrunu ca picchì â civiltà puru esistìa ntî bacini rû ciumi Sarasvati ca ora è asciuttu, s’avia a chiamari giustamenti Civiltà Indo-Sarasvati, mentri cirtuni a chiamanu Civiltà Harappan pi Harappa, u primu rî siti scavati nta l’anni Vinti.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: La natura militarìstica dû mperu rumanu aiutàu lu sviluppu dû progressu nnô setturi mèdicu.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: L'impiraturi Augustu accuminciò a ddari posti ri travagghiu a li dutturi, chi furmarunu puru u primu Corpu mèdicu rumanu ca fu usatu sùbbitu doppu l battagghi.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: I chirurghi avìanu canuscenza ri vari sidativi comu purur ra murfina ri l’istratti ri simenze r paparina e a scopolamina ri simenze ri l’èrve.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Addivintaru bravi daveru ccu l’amputazzioni pi sarbàri li pazzienti dâ cancrena comu puru ccu li lazzi emostatichi e li blocchi vasculari pi firmari li pèrditi di sangu.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Ntô cursu ri tanti siculi, u 'mpiru rumanu purtò assài guaragni ntô campu râ midicina e furmò a maggiuranza ri canuscenzi ca avemu oggi.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: L’origami Pureland è n’origami ccâ restrizzioni ca si può fari sulu na chicatura â vota, un si ponnu fari chicaturi cchiù cumplessi comu a chicatura inversa e tutti l chicaturi hannu posizziuni chiari.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Fu sviluppatu di John Smith nta l’anni Sittanta pi aiutari li chicaturi o chiḍḍi cu abbilità motòrii limitati.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Li picciriḍḍi svilùppanu la cunsapivulizza dâ razza e dî stiriòtipi razziali quannu sunnu nichi e chisti stiriòtipi razziali nfluènzanu lu cumpurtamentu.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Pi isèmpiu, i picciriḍḍi ca s’idintìficanu cû na minoranza razziali ca àvi nu stiriòtipu ca un annu bboni risurtati a scola, quannu scòprunu u stiriòtipu associatu â so razza un hannu boni risurtati â scola.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace è lu terzu situ cchiù famusu ntê Stati Uniti e avi 54 miliuni di utilizzaturi.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Chisti siti internet arriciveru àssai attinzioni, supratuttu ntô dumìniu dû 'nzignamentu e di l'educazioni.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Li cosi boni di chisti siti internet sunnu l 'istallazzioni fàcili di na pàggina di classi ccu blog, vìdiu, fotu e autri funzioni.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Chista paggina po èssiri visitata dànnucci sulu un indirizzu web, accussì è cchiù fàcili di ricurdari e digitari pî studenti ca putìssiru aviri problemi ccu li tasti o ccu lu spelling.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Si pò mudificari pi lèggiri cchiù facilmenti e macàri câ quantità di culuri ca si voli.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Lu disòrdini dû deficit di l’attinzioni “è na sindrome neurologgica cu tri sintomi classici: la mpulsività, la distrazzioni e l'iperattività o troppu enirgìa”.
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Un è na disabbilità nta l’apprennimentu, è nu disòrdini ri l’apprennimentu; “curpisci u 3 ô 5 pircentu ri tutti i picciriḍḍi, forsi puru rui miliuna ri picciriḍḍi miricani.”
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Li picciriḍḍi cu l’ADD hannu assài probblemi quannu si cuncèntranu ntô travàgghiu a scola, ma arrinèsciunu a cuncintrarisi su cosi ca ci piaci fari comu jucari o taliari li cartuna ca ci piàciunu o scrìviri frasi senza puntiggiatura.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Chisti picciriḍḍi spissu hannu guai picchì “fannu cosi rischiusi, si sciarrìanu e sfìdanu l’autorità” pi stimulari lu so ciriveḍḍu, picchì lu so ciriveḍḍu nun po èssiri stimulatu cu na manera nurmali.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: L’ADD curpisce li rilazzioni cu l’àutri cumpagni picchì l’àutri picciriḍḍi nun capìsciunu picchì si cumpòrtunu a chiḍḍa manera o picchì pàrranu a chiḍḍa manera o ca lu so livellu di maturità è diversu.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Comu l'abbilità di ottèniri canuscenza e mparari canciàu nta na manera comu chiḍḍa ca ricemmu prima supra, accussì canciò lu tassu di basi cu cui s’ottinni la canuscenza.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: L’approcciu p’ottiniri nformazzioni era diversu. La prissioni nun stava cchiù ntâ mimoria individuali, ma si cuncintraru cchiù assài supra l’abbilità di ricurdari lu testu.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Nta sustanza, u Rinascimentu fici nu canciamentu impurtanti nta l’appròcciu cu l’apprennimentu e a diffusioni râ canuscenza.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: A diffirenza di l’àutri primati, l’omìnidi nun usàvunu cchiù li manu pi muvìrisi o pi purtari pisu o pi movìrisi ntra l’àrburi.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: A manu e u peri rû scimpanzè hannu diminsiuna e artizza simili, cuosa ca rifletti l’usu râ manu pi purtari i pisi camminannu supra i rinocchia.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: La manu umana è cchiù curta dû peri, cu li falangi cchiù ritti.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: L’uossa dî manu fòssili vecchi di dui miliuna o tri miliuna di anni mostranu chistu canciamentu ntâ spicializzazzioni dâ manu, dû muvimentu â manipulazzioni.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Certi genti crìrunu ca vìviri tanti sonni lùcidi cu l’aiutu artificiali abbastanza spissu pò èssiri faticusu.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: A raggiuni principali ri stu finomenu è ca u risurtatu ri sonni lucidi aumintanu a lunghìzza rû tiempu tra i stati REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Aviri ogni notti cchiù picca REM, ca voli riri chistu statu quannu trasi ntô sonnu veru e u corpu s’arripìgghia, chista cuosa addivinta abbastanza poco friquenti e picciò nu probblema.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: È faticusu propriu comu si tu ti susìssi ogni venti o trenta minuti pi taliari a televisiuni.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: L’effettu dipenni di quantu spissu lu to ciriveḍḍu prova a insunnarisi nta na manera chiara ogni notti.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Li cosi parteru mali di principiu pi l’italiani nt l’Africa dô Nord di. Doppu una simana di la dichiarazzioni di la verra dô 10 giugnu 1940, l’unnicìsimu ussaru inglisi avìa cunquistatu Fort Capuzzo, Lìbbia.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Li 'nglisi acchiappàrunu lu 'ngigneri capu dû dècimu esèrcitu italianu, lu generali Lastucci, nta un imbuscata a Est di Bardia.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Lu 28 di giugnu, lu marasciallu Italo Balbo, guvirnaturi ginirali dâ Libbia, ca si pinzava ca avissi addivintatu eredi/succissuri di Mussolini, fu ammazzatu pi sbagghiu mentri attirrau a Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Lu sport mudernu dâ scherma si joca a diversi liveḍḍi, dî studenti universitari nzinu ê gari prufissiunìstichi e ulimpiùnichi.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Lu sport è jucatu supratuttu comu nu duellu, nu spadaccinu ca cummatti n’àutru.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Lu golf è nu jocu unni li jucatura ùsanu li mazzi pi mannari li baḍḍi ntê pirtusa.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Duranti na partita nurmali cci sunnu diciottu pirtusa, li jucatura accumìncianu cû primu pirtusu e finìscinu cû diciuttèsimu.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Lu jucaturi ca duna menu corpi o cància cchiù picca li mazzi pi finiri la partita, vinci.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Lu jocu si fa supra l’erba e l’erba attorna lu pirtusu è tunnita cchiù curta e si chiama virdi.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Forsi lu tipu di turìsimu cchiù cumuni è chiḍḍu ca li genti assòcianu cû viaggiari: lu turìsimu ricriativu.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: È chiḍḍu quannu li genti vannu nti nu postu ca è diversu dâ so vita di tutti li jorna pi ricriàrisi e scialàrisi.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Praji, parchi a tema, villaggi sunnu spissu li posti cchiù cumuni friquintati dî turisti pi divirtimentu.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Si l’ubbittivu di jiri ntîinu postu particulari è canùsciri la so storia e curtura allura chistu tipu di turìsimu si chiama turìsimu curturali.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Li turisti ponnu jiri a vìdiri diversi munumenti nna un certu pajisi o puru ponnu dicìdiri di vìdiri sulu na zona.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Li Culoni, vidennu chista attività, avìanu puru chiamatu rinforzi.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Ntra li truppi ca rinfurzàvanu li pusizzioni di davanzi cc'èranu lu primu e lu terzu riggimentu New Hampshire di 200 òmini, sutta li culunnelli John Stark e James Reed (tutti dui poi addivintaru ginirali).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: L'òmini di Stark pigghiaru pusizzioni a longu dâ barrera a nord di unni era pusizzionatu lu Culonu.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Quannu l'acqui siccaru e si grapìu nu passaggiu ntô ciumi Mystic ntâ parti autu-livantina dâ pinìsula, allungaru lesti la baragna cu nu muriceḍḍu di petra nzinu â parti auta ca fineva ô lìmiti cu l'acqua nta na prajiceḍḍa.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: O Gridley o Stark mìsiru na pala di circa 100 pedi (30 metri) 'n facciu la diga e urdinaru ca nuḍḍu avìa a sparari prima ca li surdati rigulari l’avìanu passatu.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Lu pruggettu miricanu era di fari attacchi cuurdinati di tri dirizzioni diversi.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Lu ginirali John Cadwarder avìa a fari n’attaccu divirsivu contra la guarniggiuni ngrisi a Bordertown pi bluccari tutti li rinforzi.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Lu ginirali James Ewing cunnucìu 700 milizzi attraversu lu ciumi a Trenton Ferry, pigghiau lu ponti supra Assunpink Creek e nun fici fùjiri li truppi nimichi.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: La forza d’assautu principali di 2.400 òmini travirsàu lu ciumi novi migghia a nord di Trenton, e poi si spartìu nta du' ruppi, unu sutta Greene e unu sutta Sullivan, pi fari n'attaccu prima di l’arba.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Canciannu la cursa di un quartu di migghiu a menzu migghiu, la vilucità addiventa menu mpurtanti e la risistenza addiventa na nicissità.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Certu ca n'atleta di prima catigurìa ntê cursi di menzu migghiu chi po finiri na cchiù picca di du' minuti, àvi a èssiri bastanti ràpitu, ma la risistenza àvi a èssiri disciplinata pi forza.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Quarchi cursa ntê campagni ntô nvernu, cû travagghiu â palestra pâ parti di supra dû corpu, è la megghiu priparazzioni pâ staggiuni dî cursi.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Li pràtichi nutrizziunali apprupiati suli nun ponnu criari granni pristazzioni, ma ponnu nfruiri nnô binèssiri ginirali di l'atleti jùvini.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Mantèniri nu bonu equilibbriu ntra la saluti e l’enirgìa, praticari l’abbitùdini efficaci d’idratàrisi e capiri l'aspetti diversi dî pràtichi juntivi po giuvari a l’atleti pi migghiurari li pristazzioni e aumintari lu scialu ntô sport.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: La cursa a distanza minzana è nu sport ca custa rilativamenti picca, cci sunnu assài cuncizzioni sbagghiati ncapu li riquisiti addumannati pi participari.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Li prudutti ca sèrbinu si ponnu accattari, ma gran parti ànnu picca o nuḍḍu mpattu ntâ pristazzioni.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: L’atleti ponnu sèntiri ca prifirìscinu nu pruduttu puru quannu nun duna binìfici riali.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: L’ àtumu po èssiri cunsidiratu unu dî blocchi funnamintali di tutta la materia.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: È n'entità assài cumplessa ca, sicunnu lu mudeḍḍu di Bohr simplificatu, cunzisti di un nucliu cintrali ca cci òrbitanu elettruna, comu pianeti ca òrbitanu ntornu lu suli - vidi la figura 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Lu nucliu è fattu di dui particeḍḍi - niutruna e prutuna.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Li prutuna ànnu na càrrica elèttrica pusitiva e li niutruna nun ànnu nuḍḍa càrrica. L’elittruna ànnu na càrrica elèttrica nigativa.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Pi cuntrullari la vìttima, s’àvi a sunnari prima unni la scena p'assicuràrisi di nun èssiri a rìsicu.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: S'àvi a nutari la pusizzioni dâ vittima mentri ti ci abbicini e tutti li signali di pirìculu autumàtici.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Si inusi struppija circannu di succùrriri, fa addivintari li cosi ancora peju.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Lu studiu scuprìu ca la diprissioni, lu scantu e lu catastrufìsimu mèdianu la rilazzioni tra lu duluri e la disabbilità pê genti chi soffrinu di dulura ntâ schina vascia.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Sulu l’effetti dû catastrufismu, no dâ diprissiuni e dû scantu è cunnizziunali pî sissiuna strutturati di attività fisica fatti ogni simana.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Chiḍḍi ca facevanu attività rigulari abbisugnàvanu cchiù assài ajutu pâ pircizzioni nigativa dû duluri ca fa distinziuni ntra lu duluri crònicu e lu sdisaciu dû muvimentu fìsicu nurmali.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: La visioni o l’abbilità di vìdiri dipenni di l’òrgani dû sistema sinzuriali visivu o di l'occhi.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Cci sunnu custruzzioni di l'occhi assai diffirenti, ca càncianu pi cumplessità a sicunna dî bisogni di l'urganìsimu.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Li diversi custruzzioni ànnu diversi capacità, sunnu sinzìbbili a differenti lunghizzi d’unna e ànnu diversi gradi d’acutizza, abbisògnanu puru di diversi prucessi pi capiri l’input e li diversi nùmmari pi fununziari boni.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Na pupulazzioni è nu gruppu d’urganìsimi di na speci particulari nta na spicìfica aria giugràfica.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Quannu tutti li nnividui dâ pupulazzioni sunnu spiccicati supratuttu pi nu spicìficu trattu fenutìpicu sunnu canusciuti comu monumòrfici.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Quannu li ndividui ammùstranu assài varianti pi nu spicìficu trattu sunnu polimòrfici.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Li culoni di furmìculi esèrcitu màrcianu e fannu puru lu nidu nti fasi diversi.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Ntâ fasi nòmadi, li furmìculi esèrcitu màrcianu di notti e si fèrmanu a campijari duranti lu jornu.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: La culonia accumìncia la fasi nòmadi quannu lu manciari dispunìbbili cala. Duranti chista fasi, la culonia fa nidi timpurani ca venunu canciati tutti li jorna.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Tutti sti furi nòmadi o marci dùranu circa 17 jorna.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Chi è na cèllula? La parola cèllula veni dû latinu “cella” ca significava “stanza nica”, e fu cuniata pâ prima vota d'un micruscupista ca taliava la struttura dû frummentu.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: La cèllula è l’unità basi pi tutti l’èssiri viventi, e tutti l’urganìsimi sunnu cumposti di una o cchiù assài cèlluli.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Li cèlluli sunnu accussì bàsichi e mpurtanti pi studiari la vita, ca spissu sunnu chiamati “li maduna dâ vita”.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Lu sistema nirbusu teni l’umiòstasi mannannu li mpursi nirbusi ntô corpu pi fari jiri lu flussu di sangu senza probblemi.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Chisti mpursi nirbusi ponnu èssiri spiditi assài lesti ntô corpu e chistu ajuta a tèniri lu corpu a sicuru di ogni pirìculu putinziali.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Li turnadi s'abbàttunu supra n’aria nica rispettu a autri tempesti forti, ma ponnu distrùggiri zoccu egghiè na chiḍḍa aria.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Li turnadi scìppanu l’àrbuli, stràzzanu li tàvuli nte l’edifici e tìranu li màchini nta l'airu. Lu du' pi-centu dî turnadi cchiù viulenti dùranu cchiù assai di tri uri.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Chisti tempesti-mostru ciùscianu nzinu a 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: L’umani crìanu e ùsanu lenti di ngrannimentu di migghiara e migghiara d’anni.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Comunqui, lu primu veru tiliscopiu fu criatu 'n Europa ntô XVI sèculu.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Sti tiliscopi usàvanu na cumminazzioni di du' lenti pi fari pàriri cchiù granni e vicini li cosi luntani.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Avarizzia ed eguìsimu sirannu sempri cu nui. La natura dâ cuupirazzioni voli ca quannu la majurìa àvi binifici si penza sempri a guadagnari cchiù assai nna tempi curti cumpurtànnusi eguisticamenti
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Furtunatamenti, assài genti vanu a capiri ca la so megghiu scigghiuta a longu tèrmini è travagghiari nzemi cu l’àutri.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Assài genti si sonnanu lu jornu ca l’òmini ponnu viaggiari nta n’autra stiḍḍa e esplurari àutri munni, quarcunu s’addumanna chi cc'è ḍḍà fora, quarcunu cridi ca l’alieni o àutri furmi di vita ponnu campari nti n’àutru chianita.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Eppuru, si chistu àvi a succèdiri è prubbàbbili ca nun succedi pi assài tempu. Li stiḍḍi sunnu accussì diffusi ca ḍḍà fora cci sunnu triliardi di migghia ntra li stiḍḍi “vicini”.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Forsi nu jornu li to niputi sirannu nti nu munnu alienu ca si addumànnanu dî so antichi antinati?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: L'armali sunnu fatti di cèlluli. Mancianu cosi e l'addiggirìscinu dintra. La majurìa di l'armali si po mòviri.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Sulu l'armali ànnu lu ciriveḍḍu (puru si nun tutti l'armali; pi diri, li midusi nun ànnu lu ciriveḍḍu).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: L'armali si tròvanu a tutti li banni ntâ Terra. Scàvanu ntô tirrinu, nàtanu nti l'ucèani, e vòlanu ntô celu.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Na cèllula è l’unità strutturali e funziunali cchiù nica dintra n’urganìsimu (cuosa) viventi.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Cèllula veni dâ parola latina cella ca voli diri stanza nica.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Si si talìanu li cuosi vivi sutta lu micruscopiu, si vidi ca sunnu fatti di quatrati o baḍḍi nichi.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, nu biòlugu ngrisi, vitti quatrati nichi ntô sùvaru cû micruscopiu.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Parìanu stanzi. Iḍḍu fu la prima pirsuna ca vitti cèlluli morti
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: L’elimenti e li cumposti si ponnu spustari di nu statu a n’autru e nun canciari.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Lu nitrògginu comu gas àvi li stissi prupità dû nitrògginu lìquidu. Lu statu lìquidu è cchiù densu, ma li mulèculi sunnu sempri li stissi.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: L’acqua è n’àutru esempiu. Lu compostu di l'acqua è fattu di dui àtomi di idrògginu e n'àtomu di ussìgginu.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Àvi la stissa struttura muleculari comu gas, lìquidu, o sòlidu.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Puru si lu so statu fìsicu po canciari, lu so statu chìmicu resta lu stissu.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Lu tempu è quarchi cuosa ca è ntunnu a noi, e nfluisci supra tuttu chiḍḍu ca facemu, ma è diffìcili di capiri.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Lu tempu fu studiatu di studiusi riliggiusi, filusòfici e scintìfici pi migghiara d’anni.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Facemu spirienza dû tempu comu na seri di cuosi ca succèdinu dû futuru attravessu lu prisenti nzinu ô passatu.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Lu tempu è puru comu mittemu a paraggiu la durata (lunghizza) dî fatti.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Putiti signari lu passaggiu dû tempu vuiautri stissi taliannu la ripitizzioni di fatti cìclici. Nu fattu cìclicu è quarchi cuosa ca succedi ancora e ancora nta na manera rigulari.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Li computer sunnu usati oji pi manipulari mmàggini e vidiu.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: L’animazzioni sufisticati ponnu èssiri custruiti cû computer, e st'animazzioni sunnu sempri cchiù usati ntâ telivisioni e nnê firmi.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: La mùsica spissu è riggistrata usannu computer sufisticati pi prucissari e misculijari li soni nzemi.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Pi tantu tempu ntê sèculi XIX e XX, si critti ca li primi abbitanti dâ Nova Zilanna avìanu statu li Mauri, ca cacciàvanu l'aceḍḍi enormi chiamati moa.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Dopu la tiurìa stabbilìu l’idea ca li Mauri migraru dâ Pulinesia cu na granni flotta e pigghiaru la Nova Zilanna dî Muriori, stabbilennu na sucità agrìcula.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Cumunca, li rasti novi suggirìscinu ca li Moriori foru nu gruppu di Maori cuntinintali chi emigraru dâ Nova Zilanna a l’ìsuli Chatham, sviluppannu la so curtura pacìfica e distintiva.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Cci fu puru n’àutra tribbù nti l’ìsuli Chatham, chisti èranu i Mauri ca migraru dâ Nova Zilanna.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Si chiamàvanu iḍḍi stissi Moriori. Cc'èranu na picca di sciarri armati e â fini, li Moriori foru distrutti.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Li pirsuni ca foru ntricati pi tanti dicenni n'ajutaru a apprizzari li nostri forzi e passiuna mentri valutàvanu onestamenti li difficurtà e puru li fallimenti.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Mentri ascutàvamu li pirsuni ca spartèvanu li so stori pirsunali, famigghiari e urganizzativi, pigghiàvamu nu puntu di vista di valuri supra lu passatu e quarchi pirsunalità ca nfruinzò bonu o mali la curtura di l’urganizzazzioni.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Mentri capiri la storia di unu nun ìmplica capiri la curtura, chistu ajuta armenu li pirsuni ad aviri nu senzu di unni ànnu capitatu ntâ storia di l'organizzazzioni.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Valutannu li successi e addivintannu cunsapìvuli dî fallimenti, li singuli pirsuni e tutti chiḍḍi ca participaru scòprunu cchiù prufunnamenti li valura, la missiuni, e li forzi ca cunnùciunu l’organizzazzioni.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Pi diri, arricurdari l’esempi pricidenti dû cumpurtamentu mprinnituriali e li successi risurtanti ajutaru li pirsuni a rapìrisi a novi canciamenti e novi dirizzioni pâ chiesa lucali.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Sti stori di successu calaru lu scantu dû canciamentu, criannu nclinazzioni pusitivi versu lu canciamentu ntô futuru.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Li mudeḍḍi convergenti dû pinzari sunu tècnichi di risolvimento probblemi ca accùcchiunu diversi idee o campi p’attruvari na suluzzioni.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Chista mentalità è cuncintrata supra la velocità, la lòggica e la pricisiuni, ccu l’identificazziuni dê fatti, l'applicazziuni dî tecnichi esistenti e la cugghiuta d’nformazzioni.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: L'elementu cchiù ‘mpurtanti di chista mentalità è ca di risposti boni ci ni pò èssiri una sula. Penza sulu a dui tipi di risposti, chiḍḍa giusta, e lu restu sbagghiati.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Pinzari di chista manera veni associatu cu na scienza particulari o ccu li proceduri standard.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Aviri chistu modu di rappresentazzioni voli diri aviri una manera di pinsari lòggica. Li cristiani chi pènsunu d'accussì s' arricòrdunu li schemi tècnici, arrisòlvunu probblemi e travàgghiunu ccu esami scientìfici.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: L’òmini sunnu adunca la speci cchiù talintuusa ntô lèggiri li menti di l’autri.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Chistu signìfica ca nâ fidamu a pridiri chiḍḍu ca l’autri òmini pircipìscinu, ntènninu, crìdinu, canùscinu o addisìjanu.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Ntra sti abbilità, capiri li ntinziuna di l'autri è mpurtanti. Ni lassa arrisòrbiri l’ammiguità pussìbbili di l'azzioni fìsichi.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Pi diri, s'avissi a vìdiri a quarcunu ca rumpi na finestra di na màchina, prubabbirmenti pinzassi ca sta pruvannu a rubbari na machina di nu straniu.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Avissi a èssiri giudicatu diversamenti si avissi persu li chiavi dâ màchina e fussi la so stissa màchina ca prova a rùmpiri.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: L’MRI è basata ncapu a nu finòminu fìsicu ca si chiama risunanza magnètica nucliari (NMR), ca fu scupertu nta l’anni ‘30 di Felix Bloch (ca travagghiava a Stanford University) e Edward Purcell (di l’Harvard University).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Nna chista risunanza, lu campu magnèticu e l’unni radiu facèvanu emanari all’àtumi signali radiu nichi nichi.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Nnô 1970, Raymond Damadian, nu dutturi di midicina e ricircaturi, scuprìu li basi pi usari la mmàggini dâ risunanza magnètica comu strumentu pî diàgnusi mèdichi.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Quattru anni doppu fu assignatu nu brivettu, ca fu lu primu ô munnu assignatu ntô campu di l'MRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Ntô 1977, lu dutturi Damadian finìu la custruzzioni di lu primu scanziunaturi MRI “pi tuttu lu corpu”, ca chiamò “Indomitable”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: La cumunicazzioni asìncruna ncuraggia lu tempu pî riflissiuna e li riazzioni all’autri.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: CI pirmetti ê studenti di putiri travagghiari ê casi e cuntrullari lu ritmu dî nfurmazzioni furmativi.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Ci sunnu macari picca ristrizzioni di tempu, câ pussibbilità di uri di travagghiu flissìbbili. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: L'usu di internet e dû World Wide Web pirmetti a cu' studìa di circari li nfurmazzioni quannu àvi bisognu.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Li studenti ponnu puru fari dumanni a l’istrutturi nna ogni mumentu dâ jurnata e stari a aspittari risposti bastanti ràpidi, senza bisognu d'aspittari nzinu ô ncontru facci-a-facci appressu.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: L’approcciu postmudernu a l’apprinnimentu offri la libbirtà di l’assuluti. Nun c’è sulu na manera boni di mparari.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Nfatti, nun cc’è na cosa sula bona di nzignàrisi. Lu nzignamentu mmatti ntâ la spirienza tra chiḍḍu ca si nzigna e la canuscenza prisintata.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Chistu puntu è mustratu dâ spirienza attuali ca avèmu cu tutta la prisintazzioni di fallu-tu e dî nfurmazzioni e câ telivisioni basata ncapu l’apprennimentu.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Assai di nuiautri si tròvanu a vardari prugrammi nta telivisioni ca ni nfùrmanu ncapu un processu o na spirienza unni nui nun parteciparemu mai o usaremu ḍḍa canuscenza.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Nun cazzulijaremu mai na màchina, custruiremu na funtana ntô jardinu, viaggiaremu ô Pirù pi esaminari antichi ruvini, o rimudiḍḍaremu la casa dû nostru vicinu.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Grazzi â fibbra òttica sutta a lu mari lu cavu cunnetti l’Europa cu lu satèlliti a banna larga, a Gruelannia è cunnissa bona cu lu 93% dâ pupulazzioni ca àvi accessu a l’internet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Lu vostru hotel o òspiti (si stati nta na casa vacanzi o na casa privata) avirà lu wifi o nu PC cunnissu a l’internet, e tutti i villaggi ànnu nu internet cafè o quarchi postu cu lu wifi pùbblicu.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Comu dissimu antura, puru siddu la palora “Eskimo” é accettàbbili ntâ li Stati Uniti, è cunsidirata spreggiativa di tanti cristiani chi nun sunnu di l’Àrtidi americanu, suprattuttu ntô Canadà.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Chista palora veni usata dî genti ca nasceru ntâ Groenlandia, e li furasteri nun l'avìssiru a usari.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: L’abbitanti nasciuti ntâ Groenlandia si chiamunu Inuit ntô Canada e Kalaalleq (plurali Kalaallit), veni a diri groenlandisi, intâ Groenlandia stissa.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: La criminalità e lu sceju versu li straneri 'n ginirali sunnu praticamenti scanusciuti â Grinlannia. Puru ntê cità, nun cci sunnu “zoni piriculusi”.
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Lu friddu è forsi l’ùnicu veru pirìculu ca cu' arriva mpriparatu àv’a affruntari.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Si visiti la Grinlannia duranti li staggiuna friddi (cchiù assai acchiani versu nord, cchiù friddu trovi), t’ài a purtari robbi beḍḍi caudi.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Li jurnati assai longhi duranti la stati ponnu purtari prubblemi picchì nun s’arrinesci a dòrmiri quantu si vulissi e ponnu vèniri picciò prubblemi di saluti.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Nnâ stati, stai accura ê zappagghiuna nòrdici. Puru si nun pòrtanu malatìi ponnu èssiri camurriusi.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Mentri l’econumia di San Franciscu è cunnissa cu iḍḍu essennu n’attrazzioni pi turisti ntirnazziunali, a so ecunumia è diversa.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Lu maggiuri sitturi di travagghiu sunnu li sirbizzi prufissiunali, lu guvernu, la finanza, lu cummerciu, e lu turìsimu.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Vinennu spissu riprisintata ntâ musica, film, littratura e curtura populari, la cità 'n giniralii e puru li so attrazzioni sunnu canusciuti nta tuttu lu munnu.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Franciscu diviluppau na granni nfrastruttura turìstica cu tanti hotel, risturanti, e sirbizzi pi cungressi òttimi.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Franciscu è puru unu dî megghiu posti dâ nazzioni pâ cucina asiàtica: curiana, thai, indiana e giappunisa.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Annari ô Walt Disney World è lu piḍḍigrinaggiu majiuri pi tanti famigghi miricani.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Na visita “tìpica” ìmplica vulari a l’ariuportu ntirnazziunali di Orlando, pigghiari l’autubbussu nzinu nu hotel intra a Disney, passari circa na simana senza lassari a propità di Disney, e turnari â casa.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Cci sunnu nfinuti variazzioni pussìbbili, ma chista resta chiḍḍu ca gran parti dâ genti nnica quannu parranu di “jiri unni Disney World”.
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Tanti tichetti vinnuti online ntê siti d’asti comu eBay e Craiglist sunnu parziarmenti mpicati comu tichetti pi cchiù jorna ô parcu.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Mentri chista è n’attività tantu cumuni, è pruibbita dâ Disney: i tìcchiti nun sunnu trasfirìbbili.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: P' accampàrisi sutta na gola dô Grand Canyon servi un pirmissu pì speciali pi ìri fora pista e trasiri ntê zoni sularini.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Li pirmissi sunnu limitati pi prutèggiri lu canyon e si ponnu attruvari a pàrtiri dû primu jornu dû misi, ca veni a diri quattru misi prima dû misi di partenza.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Accussì, un pirmissu pi ìri fora pista a partiri di qualsiasi jornu di maiu addiventa disponibbili dô primu di jinnaru.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Li posti ntê zoni cchiù ammuntuati comu Bright Angel Campground, vicinu a Phantom Ranch, ricìvunu dumanni a tinchité dô primu jornu quannu ràpunu li prenotazzioni.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Li pirmissi pê dumanni fatti a mumentu, senza prenotazzioni, sunu a nùmmuru limitatu. Cu arriva prima sî pìgghia.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.
